project.name: boulder
project.description: Boulder is the software that runs Let's Encrypt — an implementation of an ACME-based Certificate Authority. It is composed of gRPC-connected services (WFE, RA, VA, CA, SA, Publisher, CRL Updater) that together validate domain control and issue X.509 certificates. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project front door for Boulder, Let's Encrypt's ACME CA. Introduces the service components (WFE, RA, CA, VA, SA, publisher, etc.) and walks operators through local docker-compose development, integration testing, and working with Certbot or other ACME clients.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: One-line pointer to the Let's Encrypt community Code of Conduct. Governs participation in Boulder's issue tracker, pull requests, and community channels.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contributor handbook covering patch and review requirements, error handling conventions, feature-flag gating, deployability rules, dependency policy, release cadence, and pointers to the Go version and ACME divergence docs. Authoritative reference for Boulder code-review culture.

nodes.name: CRLS.md
nodes.summary: Describes how Boulder produces and stores sharded CRLs: the shard-assignment strategy that maps revoked certificates to a stable shard, and the storage pipeline that publishes signed CRLs for distribution.

nodes.name: DESIGN.md
nodes.summary: Sequence-diagram reference for Boulder's ACME flows across WFE, RA, SA, CA, VA, and publisher. Covers registration, orders, challenge response, finalization, and revocation for both ACME v1 and v2.

nodes.name: ISSUANCE-CYCLE.md
nodes.summary: Short narrative of Boulder's certificate issuance cycle: intake at the WFE, RA orchestration, VA validation, and CA signing. Complements DESIGN.md with a higher-level summary.

nodes.name: acme-divergences.md
nodes.summary: Enumerates the places where Boulder intentionally deviates from RFC 8555, organized by ACME section. Used by clients and auditors to reconcile unexpected behavior against the spec.

nodes.name: acme-implementation_details.md
nodes.summary: Documents Boulder-specific ACME behaviors that are permitted but unspecified by RFC 8555: authorization and order reuse, alternate chain selection, certificate request domain handling, and RSA key size policy.

nodes.name: config-validation.md
nodes.summary: Guide to Boulder's struct-tag based configuration validation. Explains how to use validator tags such as required, omitempty, structonly, min, len, hostname_port, dive, and keys/endkeys on Go config structs.

nodes.name: error-handling.md
nodes.summary: Brief pointer to Boulder's error-handling conventions, directing contributors to the patterns used in the errors package and to the CONTRIBUTING.md rules for wrapping and returning errors across gRPC boundaries.

nodes.name: health.md
nodes.summary: Explains how Boulder services expose gRPC health checks (google.health.v1) so that load balancers and orchestrators can detect component liveness and readiness.

nodes.name: logging.md
nodes.summary: Covers Boulder's structured logging conventions including AUDIT markers used for compliance-relevant events and the tooling used to verify log completeness and signatures.

nodes.name: multi-va.md
nodes.summary: Describes Boulder's Multi-Perspective Validation implementation: the primary VA delegates challenges to remote VAs and corroborates results before the RA accepts an authorization.

nodes.name: redis.md
nodes.summary: Documents how Boulder uses Redis for OCSP and CRL caching, including connection configuration, TLS setup, and debugging tips for operators triaging cache issues.

nodes.name: release.md
nodes.summary: Defines Boulder's weekly release cadence: goals, schedule, branch structure, prerequisites, the regular tagging procedure, hotfix workflow, and deployment handoff to production.

nodes.name: core/objects.go

nodes.name: AcmeStatus.IsValid
nodes.summary: Reports whether an ACME status string is one of the defined valid states (valid, pending, processing, etc.) that Boulder may use.

nodes.name: RawCertificateRequest

nodes.name: Registration

nodes.name: ValidationRecord
nodes.summary: Record of one Boulder VA validation attempt, capturing URL, resolved and tried IP addresses, port, resolver addresses, and authority metadata.

nodes.name: Challenge
nodes.summary: ACME challenge structure with type, URL, status, validation time, token, account URI, issuer domains, and per-attempt ValidationRecord slice.

nodes.name: Challenge.ExpectedKeyAuthorization
nodes.summary: Computes the ACME key authorization (token.thumbprint) a client must present, using the account JWK's JWS thumbprint.

nodes.name: Challenge.RecordsSane
nodes.summary: Validates a Challenge's ValidationRecord slice for each challenge type, enforcing shape requirements Boulder's VA must produce.

nodes.name: Challenge.CheckPending
nodes.summary: Asserts that a Challenge is in a well-formed pending state (no error, sane token, recognized type) before Boulder begins validation.

nodes.name: Challenge.StringID
nodes.summary: Derives a stable base64url-encoded FNV-128a hash of a challenge's type and token, used as an internal identifier in Boulder.

nodes.name: Authorization
nodes.summary: ACME authorization object: identifier, registration, status, expiry, challenges, wildcard flag, and optional certificate profile name.

nodes.name: Authorization.FindChallengeByStringID
nodes.summary: Looks up a Challenge on the Authorization by its StringID, returning the index or -1.

nodes.name: Authorization.SolvedBy
nodes.summary: Returns the AcmeChallenge type that put the authorization into a valid state, or an error if none or the authorization is not valid.

nodes.name: JSONBuffer.MarshalJSON
nodes.summary: Encodes a JSONBuffer as a base64url (no padding) string for ACME JSON APIs.

nodes.name: JSONBuffer.UnmarshalJSON
nodes.summary: Decodes a base64url (unpadded, padding tolerant) JSON string into a JSONBuffer for ACME message parsing.

nodes.name: Certificate
nodes.summary: Issued certificate record: ID, owning registration, serial, digest, DER bytes, issued time, and expiry, as stored by Boulder's SA.

nodes.name: CertificateStatus
nodes.summary: Per-certificate status metadata: revocation state, OCSP update time, revoked date/reason, expiration nag, issuer name ID, used by Boulder's SA and CRL pipeline.

nodes.name: SuggestedWindow
nodes.summary: ACME ARI SuggestedWindow with Start/End bounds and an IsWithin check, representing when a client should renew.

nodes.name: SuggestedWindow.IsWithin
nodes.summary: Reports whether the given time falls inside the suggested renewal window.

nodes.name: RenewalInfo
nodes.summary: ACME ARI RenewalInfo response containing a SuggestedWindow and optional ExplanationURL that Boulder's WFE returns to clients.

nodes.name: RenewalInfoSimple
nodes.summary: Builds a default ARI RenewalInfo whose suggested window spans a margin around the certificate's 2/3-lifetime renewal point.

nodes.name: RenewalInfoImmediate
nodes.summary: Returns a RenewalInfo whose suggested window sits in the immediate past, signaling clients to renew now (e.g. after revocation).

nodes.name: core.proto

nodes.name: core/util.go
nodes.summary: Shared Boulder utilities: token/serial generation, SHA-256 fingerprints, JWK digests, public-key equality, build metadata (BuildID/Time/Host), RetryBackoff, UniqueLowerNames, HashIdentifiers, LoadCert, NormalizeIssuerDomainName.

nodes.name: RandomString
nodes.summary: Returns a base64url-encoded random string of the given byte length, panicking on crypto/rand failure.

nodes.name: NewToken
nodes.summary: Generates a 32-byte random token (base64url) suitable for ACME challenge tokens in Boulder.

nodes.name: Fingerprint256
nodes.summary: Returns the SHA-256 fingerprint of a byte slice encoded as base64url without padding.

nodes.name: KeyDigest
nodes.summary: Produces a SHA-256 digest of an RSA/ECDSA public key (unwrapping *jose.JSONWebKey and *rsa/ecdsa pointer types) used throughout Boulder for key identity.

nodes.name: KeyDigestB64
nodes.summary: Returns KeyDigest output as a standard-base64 string, used when comparing JWKs by digest across Boulder services.

nodes.name: KeyDigestEquals
nodes.summary: Compares two keys by their base64 SHA-256 digests, returning false (rather than error) if either digest cannot be computed.

nodes.name: PublicKeysEqual
nodes.summary: Compares two crypto.PublicKey values using each key's typed Equal method, erroring on unrecognized key types.

nodes.name: SerialToString
nodes.summary: Formats a big.Int certificate serial as Boulder's canonical 36-character lowercase hex string.

nodes.name: StringToSerial
nodes.summary: Parses Boulder's canonical serial string back into a big.Int, validating length and hex characters first.

nodes.name: ValidSerial
nodes.summary: Returns true if the given string matches Boulder's serial format (36 hex characters) and decodes cleanly.

nodes.name: GetBuildID
nodes.summary: Reports Boulder's build identifier, populated at link time and exposed via expvar for deployment visibility.

nodes.name: GetBuildTime
nodes.summary: Reports Boulder's build timestamp from link-time-injected variables.

nodes.name: GetBuildHost
nodes.summary: Reports the hostname where the Boulder binary was built.

nodes.name: IsAnyNilOrZero
nodes.summary: Reflection-based variadic check returning true if any argument is nil, zero-valued, or an empty slice/string/map/proto Timestamp/Duration; used by Boulder gRPC handlers for required-field validation.

nodes.name: UniqueLowerNames
nodes.summary: Lowercases and de-duplicates a slice of DNS names, sorting the result for canonical use in CSRs and authorizations.

nodes.name: HashIdentifiers
nodes.summary: Normalizes an identifier slice and returns a SHA-256 hash of the joined canonical form, used to key order and authorization lookups.

nodes.name: LoadCert
nodes.summary: Reads a PEM file from disk and returns the first parsed x509.Certificate, used when Boulder binaries load issuer or trust anchors at startup.

nodes.name: RetryBackoff
nodes.summary: Computes a jittered exponential backoff duration given retry count, base, max, and factor; used by Boulder clients such as the OCSP updater.

nodes.name: IsASCII
nodes.summary: Returns true if every rune in the input string is a 7-bit ASCII character.

nodes.name: IsCanceled
nodes.summary: Reports whether an error represents a context cancellation, either via context.Canceled or gRPC code Canceled.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: Returns the basename of os.Args[0], used by Boulder binaries when they need a short self-name (e.g. for logging).

nodes.name: NormalizeIssuerDomainName
nodes.summary: Lowercases, NFC-normalizes, and IDNA-converts an issuer domain name, stripping trailing dots and rejecting empty results; ensures consistent issuer identity across Boulder.

nodes.name: checker.go
nodes.summary: Validation helpers used by the crl-checker tool: lints a freshly fetched CRL with zlint against Boulder's linter and diffs two CRLs to report added/removed serials between successive shards.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.summary: Parses a CRL DER blob, runs it through Boulder's zlint linter, verifies the issuer signature, and enforces an age limit on ThisUpdate.

nodes.name: Diff
nodes.summary: Compares two sequential CRLs for the same issuer and shard and returns the serials added and removed between them, enforcing monotonic CRL Number and ThisUpdate.

nodes.name: crl.go
nodes.summary: Shared CRL helpers used across updater, storer, and checker: derives the monotonic CRL Number from a ThisUpdate timestamp and builds stable shard identifier strings via Id.

nodes.name: Number
nodes.summary: Derives a monotonically increasing CRL Number from a ThisUpdate time by using UnixNano, ensuring successive shards always advance.

nodes.name: Id
nodes.summary: Serializes an (issuerID, shardIdx, crlNumber) triple into a JSON identifier used as the canonical CRL shard key in logs and S3 paths.

nodes.name: idp.go
nodes.summary: ASN.1 helpers for the RFC 5280 IssuingDistributionPoint CRL extension: builds the extension for user-cert or CA-cert CRLs and extracts distribution point URIs for verification.

nodes.name: MakeUserCertsExt
nodes.summary: Builds the IssuingDistributionPoint extension for a user-certificate CRL with the given distribution point URIs and the onlyContainsUserCerts flag set.

nodes.name: MakeCACertsExt
nodes.summary: Builds the IssuingDistributionPoint extension for a CA-certificate CRL with onlyContainsCACerts set and no distribution point, as used by Boulder's intermediate CRLs.

nodes.name: GetIDPURIs
nodes.summary: Parses the IssuingDistributionPoint extension out of a CRL's extension list and returns the full-name distribution point URIs, enforcing a single IDP with at least one URI.

nodes.name: storer.proto
nodes.summary: Defines the CRLStorer gRPC service with a single client-streaming UploadCRL RPC plus UploadCRLRequest and CRLMetadata messages used by crl-updater to deliver signed CRL chunks to crl-storer for S3 publication.

nodes.name: storer.go
nodes.summary: Implements the crl-storer gRPC server: streams a signed CRL from crl-updater, validates it against the expected issuer and the previous CRL in S3 (number monotonicity, IDP URIs), then uploads the new DER to the configured S3 bucket with content hash and cache-control.

nodes.name: crlStorer
nodes.summary: gRPC server state holding the S3 client, target bucket, known issuers keyed by NameID, upload metrics, logger, and clock used by the UploadCRL handler.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Constructs a crlStorer with an issuer lookup map keyed by NameID and registers the upload count and latency Prometheus metrics.

nodes.name: UploadCRL
nodes.summary: Client-streaming RPC that assembles metadata plus chunked DER, verifies the issuer signature and CRL Number monotonicity against the previous S3 object, checks IDP URIs match, then PUTs the new CRL to S3 with SHA-256 content hash and records upload metrics.

nodes.name: batch.go
nodes.summary: Single-shot crl-updater mode: fans every (issuer, shardIdx) out to a bounded worker pool, invokes updateShardWithRetry for each, and aggregates failures for the operator to act on.

nodes.name: RunOnce
nodes.summary: Runs one pass over every issuer and shard with a bounded goroutine pool, calling updateShardWithRetry and returning an error if any shard fails or the context is cancelled.

nodes.name: continuous.go
nodes.summary: Continuous crl-updater mode: jitters the first tick, then on each updatePeriod schedules every (issuer, shardIdx) through a bounded worker pool until the context is cancelled.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Long-running loop that waits a jittered startup delay, then on every updatePeriod fans all (issuer, shard) pairs through updateShardWithRetry via a bounded worker pool until ctx is done.

nodes.name: updater.go
nodes.summary: Core crl-updater implementation: leases shards in the SA, streams revoked serials by shard, pipes them through CA.GenerateCRL to sign a new CRL, streams the DER to crl-storer for S3 upload, then marks the shard updated. Owns retry/backoff and Prometheus telemetry.

nodes.name: crlUpdater
nodes.summary: Central updater state: issuer map, shard count and width, update cadence and timeout, retry limits, SA/CA/storer gRPC clients, Prometheus metrics, logger, and clock.

nodes.name: NewUpdater
nodes.summary: Constructs a crlUpdater, validating shard/time parameters and registering the tick histogram, updatedCounter, and CRL size gauges used by the crl-updater service.

nodes.name: updateShardWithRetry
nodes.summary: Leases a shard in the SA with a deadline, calls updateShard with exponential backoff up to maxAttempts, and on success records the new thisUpdate/nextUpdate back to the SA.

nodes.name: updateShard
nodes.summary: Generates one CRL shard end to end: streams revoked certs from the SA by shard, pipes metadata and entries into ca.GenerateCRL, forwards the signed DER to crl-storer's UploadCRL, and updates per-shard size/byte gauges.

nodes.name: csr/csr.go
nodes.summary: CSR validation: verifies signature, key policy, name counts/limits, and identifier types before issuance.

nodes.name: VerifyCSR
nodes.summary: Verifies a parsed CSR against key policy, signature, name-count limits, and issuance policy.

nodes.name: CNFromCSR
nodes.summary: Chooses a lowercase common name from a CSR, preferring the subject CN and falling back to the first DNS SAN.

nodes.name: CTPolicy
nodes.summary: Holds CT log groupings, publisher client, stagger duration, logger, and prometheus metrics for SCT collection.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Constructs a CTPolicy, registers prometheus metrics, and seeds shard expiry gauges from the log list.

nodes.name: GetSCTs
nodes.summary: Collects SCTs from CT logs with staggered parallel submissions until reaching a Chrome-compliant set from distinct operators.

nodes.name: compliantSet
nodes.summary: Returns any two-log SCT subset from different operators if one exists, satisfying Chrome's CT policy.

nodes.name: submitAllBestEffort
nodes.summary: Submits a precert/final cert to every applicable info/final log in parallel without blocking or reporting failures as errors.

nodes.name: SubmitFinalCert
nodes.summary: Submits the final (non-precert) certificate to all configured final CT logs as best effort.

nodes.name: ctpolicy/loglist/lintlist.go
nodes.summary: Initializes and exposes a singleton CT log list reserved for lint precert submissions.

nodes.name: InitLintList
nodes.summary: Loads and caches a singleton subset of CT logs (all informational) for use during lint/precert submissions.

nodes.name: GetLintList
nodes.summary: Returns the previously initialized lint log list singleton.

nodes.name: ctpolicy/loglist/loglist.go
nodes.summary: Parses the Chrome-style CT log list JSON into Boulder's Log structures and provides filtering by purpose, operator, expiry, and ID.

nodes.name: Log
nodes.summary: In-memory representation of a single CT log: operator, name, id, pubkey, URL, temporal window, state, tiled flag, and type.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Reads and parses a Chrome CT log list JSON file from disk into a filterable List value.

nodes.name: newHelper
nodes.summary: Converts a parsed loglist3 schema document into Boulder's operator-keyed List, including static and tiled logs.

nodes.name: SubsetForPurpose
nodes.summary: Returns a subset of logs matching the given names that are usable for the specified purpose (issuance vs informational).

nodes.name: ForTime
nodes.summary: Returns logs whose temporal shard window includes the given expiry time.

nodes.name: Shuffle
nodes.summary: Returns a randomly ordered flat slice of operator/log pairs for load-balanced submission.

nodes.name: GetByID
nodes.summary: Looks up a log by its base64-encoded id across all operators and returns it, erroring if not found.

nodes.summary: Production subscriber email template used by the expiration mailer.

nodes.name: data/staging-email.template

nodes.name: Inserter
nodes.summary: Row insertion interface with Insert.

nodes.name: Execer
nodes.summary: Arbitrary statement execution interface with ExecContext.

nodes.summary: Composite interface combining Selector and Execer for tests and helpers.

nodes.summary: Interface combining TableFor and QueryContext, satisfied by WrappedMap, used by the generic MappedSelector.

nodes.summary: Generic selector interface parameterized by model type, providing QueryContext and QueryFrom helpers.

nodes.name: WrappedMap
nodes.summary: Wrapper over gorp.DbMap exposing the Executor/DatabaseMap interface with error wrapping and transaction support.

nodes.name: MultiInserter

nodes.name: db/qmarks.go

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Generic BoulderError constructor for any ErrorType with format-style detail message; underlies the typed helpers.

nodes.name: InternalServerError

nodes.name: UnauthorizedError

nodes.name: NotFoundError

nodes.name: RateLimitError

nodes.name: goodkey/good_key.go
nodes.summary: Subscriber/CA key-quality policy engine. KeyPolicy enforces RSA/ECDSA rules (allowed curves, modulus size, small-prime rejection, Fermat close-factor check) and rejects blocked keys for both CSRs and accounts.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: Goodkey policy configuration: permitted key types, size bounds, and weak-key list location.

nodes.name: AllowedKeys
nodes.summary: Flags controlling which RSA moduli and ECDSA curves (P-256, P-384) are accepted; LetsEncryptCPS returns the Let's Encrypt CPS defaults.

nodes.name: KeyPolicy
nodes.summary: Holds compiled key-quality rules and a blocked-key lookup. GoodKey dispatches RSA/ECDSA validation, enforcing curve, modulus, small-prime, and Fermat close-factor checks.

nodes.name: LetsEncryptCPS
nodes.summary: Returns the AllowedKeys profile mandated by the Let's Encrypt CPS: RSA 2048-4096, ECDSA P-256/P-384.

nodes.name: NewPolicy
nodes.summary: Builds a KeyPolicy from a Config, loading the optional blocked-key list and applying CPS defaults when unspecified.

nodes.name: GoodKey
nodes.summary: Entry-point policy check for any crypto.PublicKey. Rejects blocked keys, dispatches to RSA/ECDSA checkers, and is called by WFE, RA, and CA before acting on subscriber keys.

nodes.name: goodKeyECDSA
nodes.summary: Validates an ECDSA public key: allowed curve, point on curve, non-zero coordinates, and N^2 <= p checks per NIST/BR.

nodes.name: goodKeyRSA
nodes.summary: Validates an RSA public key: allowed bit length, odd modulus, small-prime rejection, ROCA/Fermat close-prime detection, exponent 65537.

nodes.name: checkSmallPrimes
nodes.summary: Rejects RSA moduli divisible by small primes (products of primes under 752) as a cheap weak-key screen.

nodes.name: checkPrimeFactorsTooClose
nodes.summary: Fermat factorization screen rejecting RSA moduli whose primes are too close together (Coppersmith/Fermat attack mitigation).

nodes.name: goodkey/sagoodkey/good_key.go
nodes.summary: SA-backed variant of goodkey.NewPolicy that wires the storage-authority KeyBlocked RPC into KeyPolicy's blocked-key lookup.

nodes.name: NewPolicy
nodes.summary: Builds a KeyPolicy whose blocked-key check delegates to sa.KeyBlocked over gRPC, used by services that already have an SA client.

nodes.name: grpc/client.go
nodes.summary: Shared gRPC client constructor for Boulder services: loads TLS credentials, builds resolvers and nonce balancer registrations, wires client interceptors, and exposes Prometheus metrics.

nodes.name: ClientSetup
nodes.summary: Builds a grpc.ClientConn for Boulder services from a GRPCClientConfig: selects resolver scheme, loads mTLS credentials, installs metrics+auth interceptors, and applies timeout/backoff options.

nodes.name: grpc/creds/creds.go
nodes.summary: Custom gRPC TransportCredentials enforcing mTLS plus allow-listed SANs on both client and server. Replaces default TLS credentials so Boulder services verify peer identity via SAN names.

nodes.name: ErrSANNotAccepted
nodes.summary: Error returned when the peer certificate's SANs don't match the accepted list; signals a failed mTLS authz step.

nodes.name: clientTransportCredentials
nodes.summary: Client-side grpc.TransportCredentials that performs TLS with a pinned CA pool and expected server name.

nodes.name: serverTransportCredentials
nodes.summary: Server-side grpc.TransportCredentials that verifies the client certificate and enforces an allow-listed SAN set.

nodes.name: NewClientCredentials
nodes.summary: Constructs clientTransportCredentials with a CA pool, client cert, and expected server name for mTLS.

nodes.name: ClientHandshake
nodes.summary: Performs the client TLS handshake, validates the server certificate SAN, and returns an authenticated conn.

nodes.name: NewServerCredentials
nodes.summary: Constructs serverTransportCredentials with a TLS config and accepted-SAN allow-list for mTLS authorization.

nodes.name: validateClient
nodes.summary: Inspects the client certificate chain and confirms at least one SAN appears in the accepted set; rejects connections otherwise.

nodes.name: ServerHandshake
nodes.summary: Server-side TLS handshake that invokes validateClient on the presented certificate to enforce SAN authorization.

nodes.name: grpc/errors.go
nodes.summary: Error marshalling between BoulderError and grpc.Status. wrapError encodes typed errors for the wire; unwrapError reconstructs them on the client, mapping gRPC codes back to BoulderError types.

nodes.name: wrapError
nodes.summary: Server-side: converts a BoulderError (or generic error) into a grpc.Status carrying the BoulderError type code and detail for cross-service propagation.

nodes.name: unwrapError
nodes.summary: Client-side: parses a grpc.Status back into the corresponding BoulderError constructor (MalformedError, RateLimitError, etc.); falls back to status codes when no Boulder type is present.

nodes.name: grpc/generate.go
nodes.summary: go:generate stub that runs protogen.sh to regenerate Boulder gRPC stubs.

nodes.name: grpc/interceptors.go
nodes.summary: Boulder's gRPC interceptor stack: metadata (deadline, trace, skew), metrics, auth (SAN-to-service allow-list), and error wrap/unwrap for both unary and streaming RPCs.

nodes.name: serverMetadataInterceptor
nodes.summary: Server interceptor that parses incoming metadata (client deadline, trace id), enforces clock-skew checks, and records request latency.

nodes.name: clientMetadataInterceptor
nodes.summary: Client interceptor that injects deadline and trace metadata and surfaces gRPC errors through unwrapError.

nodes.name: authInterceptor
nodes.summary: Server interceptor that enforces per-method authorization: verifies the peer's TLS SAN is allow-listed for the called RPC service.

nodes.name: interceptedServerStream
nodes.summary: Wraps grpc.ServerStream to override Context with metadata-enriched context for streaming RPCs.

nodes.name: interceptedClientStream
nodes.summary: Wraps grpc.ClientStream so SendMsg/RecvMsg/CloseSend errors flow through unwrapError for BoulderError recovery.

nodes.name: Unary
nodes.summary: Unary server interceptor: reads request metadata, enforces deadlines and clock skew, records metrics, and forwards to the handler.

nodes.name: Stream
nodes.summary: Streaming server interceptor mirroring Unary: propagates metadata, enforces skew, measures latency.

nodes.name: checkLatency
nodes.summary: Compares server-observed duration to the client-provided deadline, emitting deadlineDetails errors when the RPC overran.

nodes.name: Unary
nodes.summary: Unary client interceptor: stamps deadline/trace metadata on outgoing context and unwraps returned gRPC status into BoulderError.

nodes.name: Stream
nodes.summary: Streaming client interceptor that returns an interceptedClientStream wrapping Send/Recv/CloseSend for error translation.

nodes.name: checkContextAuth
nodes.summary: Core of authInterceptor: extracts peer TLS info from context, collects SANs, and checks them against the per-method allow-list from config.

nodes.name: grpc/internal/backoff/backoff.go
nodes.summary: Vendored copy of grpc-go's exponential backoff strategy used by Boulder's custom DNS resolver for retry timing.

nodes.name: Exponential
nodes.summary: Exponential backoff implementation with jitter; Backoff(retries) returns a duration with randomization.

nodes.name: Backoff
nodes.summary: Computes the next backoff duration given retry count, applying multiplier, cap, and jitter factors.

nodes.name: grpc/internal/grpcrand/grpcrand.go
nodes.summary: Vendored grpc-go internal random source wrapping math/rand with a mutex for concurrent access; used by backoff and balancers.

nodes.name: grpc/internal/leakcheck/leakcheck.go
nodes.summary: Vendored goroutine-leak detector for gRPC tests; reports goroutines left running after a test completes.

nodes.name: RegisterIgnoreGoroutine
nodes.summary: Adds a substring to the ignore list so background goroutines containing it are excluded from leak reports.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Test helper that asserts no interesting goroutines remain, polling a few times before reporting a leak.

nodes.name: grpc/internal/resolver/dns/dns_resolver.go
nodes.summary: SRV-aware gRPC resolver used by Boulder clients. Schemes (dns, nonce-srv, nonce-srv-v2) drive SRV lookups via bdns and feed address lists plus nonce attributes into the balancer.

nodes.name: srvBuilder
nodes.summary: grpc resolver.Builder implementation for SRV-based schemes; Build constructs dnsResolver and Scheme returns the scheme name.

nodes.name: dnsResolver
nodes.summary: Watches DNS SRV records for a target, pushing updated addresses and attributes to the grpc.ClientConn, with backoff on errors and Close for shutdown.

nodes.name: NewDefaultSRVBuilder
nodes.summary: Returns a resolver.Builder for the 'dns' scheme that resolves gRPC SRV records with no nonce annotations.

nodes.name: NewNonceSRVBuilder
nodes.summary: Returns a resolver.Builder for the 'nonce-srv' scheme that attaches nonce-prefix attributes used by noncebalancerv1.

nodes.name: NewNonceSRVBuilderV2
nodes.summary: Returns a resolver.Builder for the 'nonce-srv-v2' scheme that feeds noncebalancer (v2) the prefix-to-host map.

nodes.name: Build
nodes.summary: Resolver builder entry: parses the target URL, starts a watcher goroutine performing periodic SRV lookups, and returns the live dnsResolver.

nodes.name: watcher
nodes.summary: Long-running goroutine that re-runs SRV lookups on a ticker or when ResolveNow signals, reporting state to the grpc.ClientConn.

nodes.name: lookupSRV
nodes.summary: Issues SRV lookup via the injected netResolver, filters to known nonce prefixes, and returns an Addresses slice plus attributes.

nodes.name: handleDNSError
nodes.summary: Translates DNS lookup errors into resolver state updates; backs off before retrying to avoid thundering-herd.

nodes.name: grpc/internal/testutils/channel.go
nodes.summary: Buffered channel helper for tests that drops-on-overflow (Replace) and supports Send/Receive with timeouts for deterministic gRPC tests.

nodes.name: Channel
nodes.summary: Test helper wrapping a buffered chan interface{} with blocking/timeout Send, Receive, and Replace semantics.

nodes.name: grpc/internal/testutils/parse_url.go
nodes.summary: Test helper MustParseURL that panics on error; used by resolver and balancer tests to construct targets.

nodes.name: MustParseURL
nodes.summary: Parses a URL or panics; convenience for test fixtures building resolver targets.

nodes.name: grpc/noncebalancer/noncebalancer.go
nodes.summary: Prefix-based gRPC balancer (v2) that routes a Redeem RPC to the nonce-service backend whose prefix matches the client-supplied nonce, enabling stateless nonce servers behind load balancing.

nodes.name: prefixBasedPicker
nodes.summary: grpc.Picker that selects a SubConn based on a nonce prefix attached to the RPC context; fails the call if no matching backend is known.

nodes.name: nonceBalancer
nodes.summary: grpc.Balancer that wraps base balancer, consuming resolver state (prefix-to-addr attributes) to keep the prefixBasedPicker map current.

nodes.name: Pick
nodes.summary: Extracts the nonce prefix from the RPC context (PickInfo) and returns the matching SubConn, or ErrNoSubConnAvailable if unknown.

nodes.name: UpdateState
nodes.summary: Balancer UpdateState hook: consumes the DNS resolver's per-SubConn prefix attribute and rebuilds the prefix->SubConn map used for picking.

nodes.name: grpc/noncebalancerv1/noncebalancer.go
nodes.summary: Legacy v1 prefix-based nonce balancer retained for backward compatibility alongside the v2 implementation. Same purpose: route Redeem RPCs to the nonce server matching the nonce prefix.

nodes.name: picker
nodes.summary: v1 nonce picker: selects SubConn by nonce prefix using a prebuilt map from the resolver.

nodes.name: Build
nodes.summary: Constructs a v1 picker from the base.PickerBuildInfo, reading nonce-prefix attributes from each SubConn's address.

nodes.name: Pick
nodes.summary: v1 Pick implementation routing Redeem calls by nonce prefix; falls back to a round-robin picker for other RPCs.

nodes.name: grpc/pb-marshalling.go
nodes.summary: Hand-written converters between Boulder domain types (Registration, Authorization, Challenge, ValidationRecord, ProblemDetails) and their protobuf equivalents; underpins all inter-service RPCs.

nodes.name: ProblemDetailsToPB
nodes.summary: Encodes probs.ProblemDetails (ACME error body) into the wire proto for inclusion in validation and authorization RPC responses.

nodes.name: PBToProblemDetails
nodes.summary: Decodes the wire proto form of ProblemDetails back into probs.ProblemDetails on the client side.

nodes.name: ChallengeToPB
nodes.summary: Encodes a core.Challenge (validation type, token, status, records, error) into the challenge protobuf for RA<->VA and RA<->SA RPCs.

nodes.name: PBToChallenge
nodes.summary: Decodes a challenge proto back into core.Challenge, recovering validation records and ProblemDetails on failures.

nodes.name: ValidationRecordToPB
nodes.summary: Converts core.ValidationRecord (HTTP-01/DNS-01 audit trail) into its proto form for transmission from VA to RA.

nodes.name: PBToValidationRecord
nodes.summary: Decodes a ValidationRecord proto back into the core struct, reconstructing addresses, URL, and DNSSEC flags.

nodes.name: ValidationResultToPB
nodes.summary: Encodes a VA validation result (records + problem) into the proto used for PerformValidation RPC responses.

nodes.name: CAAResultToPB
nodes.summary: Encodes a VA CAA-check result (present flag and any problem) into its proto form for IsCAAValid RPCs.

nodes.name: RegistrationToPB
nodes.summary: Encodes a core.Registration (ACME account: key, contact, status, agreement) into the proto form used by SA and RA.

nodes.name: PbToRegistration
nodes.summary: Decodes a Registration proto back into core.Registration, reconstructing the JWK and timestamps.

nodes.name: AuthzToPB
nodes.summary: Encodes a core.Authorization (identifier, status, challenges, expiry) into the proto exchanged between SA and RA.

nodes.name: PBToAuthz
nodes.summary: Decodes an Authorization proto back into core.Authorization, including embedded challenges.

nodes.name: PBToAuthzMap
nodes.summary: Converts a map keyed by identifier from proto form to the core map used by RA's order flow.

nodes.name: grpc/protogen.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script invoked via go:generate to regenerate Boulder's gRPC stubs from .proto files using protoc-gen-go and protoc-gen-go-grpc.

nodes.name: grpc/server.go
nodes.summary: Shared gRPC server constructor for Boulder services. serverBuilder assembles services, wires mTLS credentials, health checks, auth/metric interceptors, and graceful-stop lifecycle.

nodes.name: serverBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder pattern for Boulder gRPC servers: accumulates services via Add, configures health-check interval, and Build returns a started grpc.Server with interceptors and listeners.

nodes.name: checker
nodes.summary: Service-provided health-check hook invoked by the long-running health loop to report SERVING/NOT_SERVING.

nodes.name: NewServer
nodes.summary: Factory that returns a fresh serverBuilder for constructing a Boulder gRPC server.

nodes.name: WithCheckInterval
nodes.summary: Builder option to set the health-check polling interval for long-running checks.

nodes.name: Add
nodes.summary: Registers a Boulder gRPC service (name, registrar, and optional checker) on the serverBuilder; validated against the ServerConfig allow-list.

nodes.name: Build
nodes.summary: Materializes the gRPC server: loads TLS + service allow-list, installs server interceptors (metrics, auth, metadata), registers services + health, and returns start/stop funcs.

nodes.name: initLongRunningCheck
nodes.summary: Starts a background goroutine that periodically calls each service's checker and publishes SERVING/NOT_SERVING to the gRPC health server.

nodes.name: grpc/skew.go
nodes.summary: Production clock-skew tolerance constant (seconds) used by serverMetadataInterceptor to reject RPCs whose client clock is too far off.

nodes.name: grpc/skew_integration.go
nodes.summary: Build-tagged clock-skew override used in integration tests to loosen tolerance when simulating time drift.

nodes.name: grpc/test_proto/generate.go
nodes.summary: go:generate stub regenerating the interceptors_test proto used only by grpc package tests.

nodes.name: grpc/test_proto/interceptors_test.proto
nodes.summary: Minimal protobuf service definition used to exercise Boulder's gRPC interceptor stack in unit tests.

nodes.name: iana/iana.go
nodes.summary: Public suffix extraction helper used by Boulder policy and CAA code. Wraps weppos/publicsuffix-go DefaultList to return the effective TLD+1 suffix for an input name.

nodes.name: ExtractSuffix
nodes.summary: Returns the publicsuffix rule for a DNS name using publicsuffix.DefaultList. Used by Boulder's policy authority and validation paths to identify TLD/eTLD boundaries for CAA and high-risk-name checks.

nodes.name: iana/ip.go
nodes.summary: IANA IPv4/IPv6 special-use registry enforcement. Loads embedded CSV data listing reserved prefixes (loopback, documentation, RFC1918, etc.) at init and exposes IsReservedAddr/IsReservedPrefix guards used by the VA and RA to refuse validation and issuance for non-routable IPs.

nodes.name: reservedPrefix
nodes.summary: Internal record describing one entry from the IANA special-use prefix registry (prefix plus the policy flags that gate its reachability). Backs the IsReservedAddr/IsReservedPrefix lookups.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Package init that parses the embedded IANA IPv4 and IPv6 special-purpose-address CSV files into the reservedPrefixes slice. Failure panics the binary so operators catch bad data at startup.

nodes.name: parseReservedPrefixFile
nodes.summary: Parses one IANA special-use address CSV, decoding the prefix and the forwardable/global/reserved flags into reservedPrefix records that IsReserved* consult.

nodes.name: IsReservedAddr
nodes.summary: Reports whether a netip.Addr falls inside any IANA special-use prefix that Boulder treats as non-issuable. Used by the policy authority and VA to reject disallowed IP identifiers.

nodes.name: IsReservedPrefix
nodes.summary: Reports whether a netip.Prefix overlaps any IANA special-use range. Used to reject issuance or validation against reserved CIDRs.

nodes.name: identifier/identifier.go
nodes.summary: Defines ACMEIdentifier, the DNS/IP identifier type flowing through every Boulder service. Provides constructors, proto marshalling, CSR/cert extraction, and canonical Normalize/ToValues helpers used by RA, WFE, VA, CA, and SA.

nodes.name: ACMEIdentifier
nodes.summary: Central value type pairing an identifier Type (dns/ip) with a normalized Value. Used as the canonical identifier representation across order, authorization, challenge, and certificate flows.

nodes.name: IsValid
nodes.summary: Returns true if the identifier type is one of the supported ACME identifier kinds (dns or ip). Gate used when accepting orders and authorizations.

nodes.name: ToProto
nodes.summary: Marshals an ACMEIdentifier to the corepb proto form carried on RA/SA/CA gRPC requests.

nodes.name: FromProto
nodes.summary: Unmarshals a corepb Identifier into the in-process ACMEIdentifier value used by Boulder services.

nodes.name: ToProtoSlice
nodes.summary: Batch-converts a slice of ACMEIdentifier to the proto slice carried by order and authorization RPCs.

nodes.name: FromProtoSlice
nodes.summary: Batch-converts a proto identifier slice into native ACMEIdentifiers, used when hydrating orders and authorizations off the wire.

nodes.name: NewDNS
nodes.summary: Constructs a DNS-type ACMEIdentifier for a domain name; primary entry point used by PA, WFE, and tests when building identifiers from raw strings.

nodes.name: NewDNSSlice
nodes.summary: Builds a slice of DNS ACMEIdentifiers from raw domain strings. Convenience wrapper for order/authz construction.

nodes.name: NewIP
nodes.summary: Constructs an IP-type ACMEIdentifier, normalizing via netip.Addr to canonical form for policy comparisons and storage.

nodes.name: FromString
nodes.summary: Parses a raw string into the correct ACMEIdentifier kind, preferring IP if the value parses as an address and otherwise treating it as a DNS name.

nodes.name: FromStringSlice
nodes.summary: Converts a slice of raw identifier strings into ACMEIdentifiers using FromString. Used by config and test harness loaders.

nodes.name: fromX509
nodes.summary: Extracts ACMEIdentifiers from an X.509 SAN set, walking DNS names and IP addresses. Shared helper behind FromCert and FromCSR.

nodes.name: FromCert
nodes.summary: Returns the identifier set contained in an x509.Certificate's SAN, used when reconciling stored certs against orders.

nodes.name: FromCSR
nodes.summary: Returns the identifier set contained in a CertificateRequest's SAN; used by the RA to cross-check finalize requests against the order's identifiers.

nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.summary: Lowercases DNS names, canonicalizes IP addresses, strips leading wildcards, and sorts/dedupes an identifier slice so equal orders hash identically regardless of client input style.

nodes.name: ToValues
nodes.summary: Splits an ACMEIdentifier slice into separate DNS and IP string slices, producing the shape SA/CA/CSR builders expect.

nodes.name: issuance/cert.go
nodes.summary: Boulder issuance profile and certificate signing core. Defines Profile/ProfileConfig (validity, lint/include policy, CT, OCSP, CRL URLs), IssuanceRequest, Prepare (template + lint), Issue (final signature), and RequestFromPrecert for precert-to-final linting. Backs every CA-side signing of leaf certificates.

nodes.name: ProfileConfig
nodes.summary: JSON-loadable issuance profile: validity window, whether to allow MustStaple/CT poison/common-name, OCSP and CRL URLs, max validity, and key policy. Hydrated from CA config into a live Profile.

nodes.name: Profile
nodes.summary: Runtime issuance profile derived from ProfileConfig. Used by the CA signer to validate IssuanceRequests and stamp fields on precerts and final certs.

nodes.name: NewProfile
nodes.summary: Validates a ProfileConfig and compiles it into a Profile. Enforces sane bounds on validity periods and the presence of required URLs, rejecting misconfiguration at startup.

nodes.name: GenerateValidity
nodes.summary: Produces NotBefore/NotAfter bounds for a new certificate given the profile's MaxValidity window and a backdate. Centralizes Boulder's validity math.

nodes.name: requestValid
nodes.summary: Internal policy gate: verifies an IssuanceRequest against its Profile (key type, extensions, SANs, CT policy, MustStaple allowance) before the CA signs.

nodes.name: MarshalablePublicKey
nodes.summary: Wrapper around crypto.PublicKey that exposes a stable JSON representation; used so IssuanceRequest/Response audit logs serialize cleanly.

nodes.name: IssuanceRequest
nodes.summary: Inputs to a signing operation: public key, identifiers, serial, notBefore/notAfter, CT precert flag, optional SCT list, and MustStaple/CommonName hints. Passed from CA to Issuer.Prepare/Issue.

nodes.name: Prepare
nodes.summary: Builds the unsigned tbsCertificate template from an IssuanceRequest and Profile, applies policy, and runs Boulder's pre-signature linter. Produces the issuanceToken handed to Issue. This is the single chokepoint where every Boulder leaf cert's fields are composed.

nodes.name: Issue
nodes.summary: Consumes a single-use issuanceToken produced by Prepare and returns the signed DER certificate. Splitting Prepare/Issue lets the CA batch linting and hold the HSM signing call to the critical section.

nodes.name: RequestFromPrecert
nodes.summary: Reconstructs an IssuanceRequest for the final certificate from a precertificate plus its embedded SCTs, so the CA can sign the matching end-entity cert after CT submission.

nodes.name: issuance/crl.go
nodes.summary: CRL profile and signing helper used by Boulder's crl-updater. Defines CRLProfileConfig/CRLProfile (validity, IDP), CRLRequest, and IssueCRL which constructs the tbsCertList, applies the Boulder CRL linter, and asks the Issuer to sign.

nodes.name: CRLProfileConfig
nodes.summary: Config structure for CRL issuance: validity, backdate, and distribution point URI template used to populate the IDP extension.

nodes.name: CRLProfile
nodes.summary: Compiled CRL profile used at runtime to stamp ThisUpdate/NextUpdate and IDP onto each Boulder-signed CRL.

nodes.name: NewCRLProfile
nodes.summary: Validates a CRLProfileConfig and returns a CRLProfile; rejects validity or URL settings that violate Boulder's CP/CPS at startup.

nodes.name: CRLRequest
nodes.summary: Input to IssueCRL: the CRL number, revoked certs, thisUpdate, and the shard identifier that the IDP URL template consumes.

nodes.name: IssueCRL
nodes.summary: Builds the unsigned CRL bytes for a shard, runs Boulder's CRL-specific zlint suite (cpcps IDP, AIA, reason codes, timestamps), and signs via the Issuer. The crl-updater reaches this per shard each interval.

nodes.name: issuance/issuer.go
nodes.summary: Defines Boulder's Issuer: an in-memory handle to an intermediate CA certificate plus its HSM-backed signer. Loads PKCS11 or file-based keys, computes SubjectNameID/IssuerNameID truncated hashes used as shard and issuer identifiers throughout Boulder, and exposes LoadChain for linter/OCSP paths.

nodes.name: SubjectNameID
nodes.summary: Returns the 64-bit truncated SHA1 of an issuer's Subject DER. Used as the primary key for issuer lookups across CA/SA/OCSP/CRL tables.

nodes.name: IssuerNameID
nodes.summary: Returns the 64-bit truncated SHA1 of a certificate's Issuer DER; mirrors SubjectNameID from the leaf's perspective for issuer lookups.

nodes.name: Certificate
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper around x509.Certificate that caches a NameID; used to represent an intermediate CA cert within Boulder's loaded issuer set.

nodes.name: NameID
nodes.summary: Returns the cached truncated-SHA1 NameID for a Certificate, the key used for all issuer bookkeeping in Boulder.

nodes.name: NewCertificate
nodes.summary: Constructs an issuance.Certificate from an x509.Certificate, pre-computing and caching its NameID.

nodes.name: LoadCertificate
nodes.summary: Reads a PEM file from disk and returns the parsed issuance.Certificate; convenience wrapper used by Boulder CA and tool setup.

nodes.name: LoadChain
nodes.summary: Validates a chain of *Certificate, ensuring each signs the next and the root is self-signed, and returns the ordered chain used to hand out with issued certs.

nodes.name: IssuerConfig
nodes.summary: Operator-facing config for one Boulder issuer: certificate path, signer location (PKCS11/file), chain, profiles, and active flag. Decoded from CA config.

nodes.name: IssuerLoc
nodes.summary: Location of an issuer's signing key: either a PKCS11 module reference (slot, label, pin) or a file path for tests.

nodes.name: Issuer
nodes.summary: Runtime handle combining the issuer cert, its HSM-backed crypto.Signer, active-status flag, and the set of configured Profiles. Core object the CA signs with.

nodes.name: newIssuer
nodes.summary: Assembles an Issuer from an IssuerConfig plus an already-loaded signer, wiring profiles and chain. Enforces profile name uniqueness and signer/cert key agreement.

nodes.name: KeyType
nodes.summary: Reports whether an Issuer signs with RSA or ECDSA; used when matching subscriber key types to allowed issuers.

nodes.name: IsActive
nodes.summary: Reports whether this Issuer is currently eligible to issue new certificates; inactive issuers remain loaded for signing OCSP/CRL only.

nodes.name: Name
nodes.summary: Returns the common name of the issuer certificate; used for logging and metric labels.

nodes.name: Profiles
nodes.summary: Returns the issuer's configured profile map by name so the CA can look up an issuance policy by client-requested profile.

nodes.name: LoadIssuer
nodes.summary: Top-level loader: reads the issuer certificate, opens the signer at its IssuerLoc, and constructs a fully configured Issuer. Entry point used by the CA at startup.

nodes.name: loadSigner
nodes.summary: Opens a crypto.Signer for an IssuerLoc: either a PKCS11 session against the HSM or a software signer for tests, checking the key matches the issuer certificate.

nodes.name: linter/linter.go
nodes.summary: Boulder's pre-issuance linter harness. Wraps zmap/zlint, registering Boulder-specific lints under cabf_br/chrome/cpcps/rfc, generates a throwaway matching key to produce a temporary signed certificate or CRL, and runs the registered lint suite before the real signer commits.

nodes.name: Linter
nodes.summary: Holds a throwaway signer matching the real issuer key type plus the zlint Registry of enabled Boulder lints. Shared across issuance workers so per-request Check calls are cheap.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Top-level Check (package function) that constructs a Linter on demand and runs the cert lint suite; convenience wrapper for callers that do not cache a Linter.

nodes.name: CheckCRL
nodes.summary: Top-level CheckCRL that constructs a Linter and runs the CRL lint suite over a tbsCertList; used by ad-hoc callers.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Constructs a Linter bound to a real issuer, generating an in-memory key pair that matches the issuer's algorithm/bitsize so temporary-signed lint certs validate.

nodes.name: makeSigner
nodes.summary: Generates an ephemeral RSA or ECDSA signer matching a reference key, used so lint certs can be signed in-memory without touching the HSM.

nodes.name: makeIssuer
nodes.summary: Builds a throwaway x509 issuer cert using the ephemeral signer so the cert under test chains to a lint-only root inside the zlint harness.

nodes.name: NewRegistry
nodes.summary: Returns a zlint Registry filtered to Boulder's enabled lint set (cabf_br, chrome, cpcps, rfc) with ignore list applied. Centralizes which lints Boulder runs.

nodes.name: makeLintCert
nodes.summary: Takes a tbsCertificate template and signs it with the ephemeral signer so the zlint suite can parse a complete certificate.

nodes.name: ProcessResultSet
nodes.summary: Converts a zlint ResultSet into an error if any enabled lint reported Error/Warn/Notice at a level Boulder treats as fatal. Boulder's policy hook over zlint output.

nodes.name: makeLintCRL
nodes.summary: Signs a tbsCertList with the ephemeral signer so the CRL lint suite can parse and inspect it before the real issuer commits.

nodes.name: linter/lints/cabf_br/lint_crl_acceptable_reason_codes.go
nodes.summary: Boulder lint enforcing CA/Browser Forum BR requirements on CRL entry reason codes: only BR-approved codes may appear in CRL entryExtensions. Runs inside Boulder's CRL lint suite.

nodes.name: NewCrlAcceptableReasonCodes
nodes.summary: zlint constructor returning the lint struct that validates each revoked entry's reasonCode against the BR-approved set.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Walks CRL revoked entries and flags any reasonCode outside the BR-permitted set (keyCompromise, affiliationChanged, superseded, cessationOfOperation, privilegeWithdrawn).

nodes.name: linter/lints/cabf_br/lint_crl_no_critical_reason_codes.go
nodes.summary: Boulder lint: CRL reasonCode entryExtensions must not be critical per the BRs. Flags any reasonCode extension marked critical.

nodes.name: NewCrlCriticalReasonCodes
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the non-critical reasonCode lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Fails if any CRL revoked entry's reasonCode extension is marked critical; criticality is forbidden by the BRs.

nodes.name: linter/lints/cabf_br/lint_crl_validity_period.go
nodes.summary: Boulder lint enforcing BR maximum CRL validity windows (thisUpdate to nextUpdate) with shorter bounds for subscriber vs. subordinate/root CA CRLs. Runs inside the CRL suite.

nodes.name: NewCrlValidityPeriod
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the BR CRL validity-window lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Enforces the BR-mandated thisUpdate to nextUpdate limit for the CRL, with separate thresholds for subscriber-issuing CAs vs. CA-issuing CAs, and flags missing nextUpdate.

nodes.name: linter/lints/chrome/e_scts_from_same_operator.go
nodes.summary: Boulder lint enforcing Chrome CT Policy: the embedded SCT list must include SCTs from at least two distinct CT log operators. Runs against finalized certs with embedded SCTs.

nodes.name: NewSCTsFromSameOperator
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the Chrome SCT distinct-operator lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Parses each embedded SCT, maps log IDs to operators via ctpolicy loglist, and fails when fewer than two distinct operators are represented.

nodes.name: linter/lints/common.go
nodes.summary: Shared helpers used by Boulder's custom lints: IssuingDistributionPoint struct, GetExtWithOID for pulling an extension by OID, and ReadOptionalASN1BooleanWithTag for IDP flag parsing.

nodes.name: IssuingDistributionPoint
nodes.summary: Parsed representation of the CRL issuingDistributionPoint extension used by Boulder's CRL lints to assert IDP shape matches CPS.

nodes.name: NewIssuingDistributionPoint
nodes.summary: Returns a zero-valued IssuingDistributionPoint for lint construction helpers.

nodes.name: GetExtWithOID
nodes.summary: Returns the first pkix.Extension with the given OID from an extension slice; used by every Boulder lint that targets a specific extension.

nodes.name: ReadOptionalASN1BooleanWithTag
nodes.summary: Parses an optional ASN.1 BOOLEAN with an implicit tag, used by IDP parsing to read onlyContainsUserCerts / onlyContainsCACerts / onlyContainsAttributeCerts flags.

nodes.name: linter/lints/cpcps/lint_crl_has_idp.go
nodes.summary: Boulder CP/CPS lint verifying each CRL carries an issuingDistributionPoint extension that matches Boulder's sharding URL scheme. Central compliance check for Boulder's sharded CRLs.

nodes.name: NewCrlHasIDP
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for Boulder's CP/CPS IDP-presence lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Parses the IDP extension, enforces criticality, exactly one distributionPoint URI, presence of onlyContainsUserCerts or onlyContainsCACerts, and rejects forbidden fields (onlySomeReasons, indirectCRL).

nodes.name: parseDistributionPointName
nodes.summary: Decodes the distributionPointName choice inside an IDP, returning the single URI expected by Boulder's shard URL policy.

nodes.name: linter/lints/cpcps/lint_crl_has_no_aia.go
nodes.summary: Boulder CP/CPS lint: CRLs must not carry an Authority Information Access extension. Flags any CRL containing an AIA extension.

nodes.name: NewCrlHasNoAIA
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for Boulder's no-AIA-in-CRL lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Fails if the AIA OID extension appears in the CRL's extensions list.

nodes.name: linter/lints/cpcps/lint_crl_has_no_cert_issuers.go
nodes.summary: Boulder CP/CPS lint: CRL entries must not carry certificateIssuer extensions (Boulder doesn't issue indirect CRLs).

nodes.name: NewCrlHasNoCertIssuers
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for Boulder's no-certificateIssuer lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Walks revoked entry extensions and fails if any entry carries a certificateIssuer extension.

nodes.name: linter/lints/cpcps/lint_crl_is_not_delta.go
nodes.summary: Boulder CP/CPS lint: CRLs must not be delta CRLs. Flags presence of the deltaCRLIndicator extension.

nodes.name: NewCrlIsNotDelta
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the no-delta-CRL lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Fails the CRL if the deltaCRLIndicator extension is present.

nodes.name: linter/lints/cpcps/lint_root_ca_cert_validity_period_greater_than_25_years.go
nodes.summary: Boulder CP/CPS lint: root CA certs must not have a validity period longer than 25 years.

nodes.name: NewRootCACertValidityTooLong
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the root CA 25-year cap lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Fails if NotAfter minus NotBefore exceeds 25 years for a root CA certificate.

nodes.name: linter/lints/cpcps/lint_subordinate_ca_cert_validity_period_greater_than_8_years.go
nodes.summary: Boulder CP/CPS lint: subordinate (intermediate) CA certs must not have a validity period longer than 8 years.

nodes.name: NewSubordinateCACertValidityTooLong
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the subordinate CA 8-year cap lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Fails if NotAfter minus NotBefore exceeds 8 years for a subordinate CA certificate.

nodes.name: linter/lints/cpcps/lint_subscriber_cert_validity_greater_than_100_days.go
nodes.summary: Boulder CP/CPS lint: subscriber leaf certs must not have a validity period longer than 100 days.

nodes.name: NewSubscriberCertValidityTooLong
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the subscriber 100-day cap lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Fails if NotAfter minus NotBefore exceeds 100 days for a subscriber leaf certificate.

nodes.name: linter/lints/cpcps/lint_validity_period_has_extra_second.go
nodes.summary: Boulder CP/CPS lint: cert validity periods must be rounded (no off-by-one second) to match Boulder's issuance arithmetic.

nodes.name: NewCertValidityNotRound
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the non-rounded validity-period lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Fails when NotAfter minus NotBefore is not an integral number of seconds matching Boulder's expected multiples (catches the common off-by-one-second bug).

nodes.name: linter/lints/rfc/lint_cert_via_pkimetal.go
nodes.summary: Boulder lint that POSTs each candidate certificate to a PKIMetal remote service for multi-linter consensus (zlint/pkilint/x509lint) and translates findings into zlint results.

nodes.name: PKIMetalConfig
nodes.summary: Config for the PKIMetal integration: endpoint URL, request timeout, and which backend linters to enable.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Internal helper that encodes the cert, POSTs to the PKIMetal /v1/lint/cert endpoint, parses the JSON response, and converts each finding to a zlint LintResult with the correct status.

nodes.name: NewCertViaPKIMetal
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the PKIMetal certificate lint.

nodes.name: Configure
nodes.summary: Returns the zlint Configurable hook describing PKIMetalConfig so operators can set endpoint/timeout via config.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Public Execute entry point that delegates to the internal execute helper to run the PKIMetal lint against the certificate.

nodes.name: linter/lints/rfc/lint_crl_has_aki.go
nodes.summary: Boulder RFC 5280 lint: CRLs must carry a non-critical authorityKeyIdentifier extension containing the issuer's keyIdentifier.

nodes.name: NewCrlHasAKI
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the CRL AKI-presence lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Fails the CRL when the AKI extension is missing, marked critical, or lacks a keyIdentifier field.

nodes.name: linter/lints/rfc/lint_crl_has_issuer_name.go
nodes.summary: Boulder RFC 5280 lint: CRLs must have a non-empty issuer Name matching the parent CA's Subject DN.

nodes.name: NewCrlHasIssuerName
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the CRL issuer-name lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Fails when the CRL's Issuer RDN sequence is empty.

nodes.name: linter/lints/rfc/lint_crl_has_number.go
nodes.summary: Boulder RFC 5280 lint: CRLs must carry a non-critical CRLNumber extension with a positive INTEGER value.

nodes.name: NewCrlHasNumber
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the CRLNumber lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Fails when the CRLNumber extension is missing, critical, negative, zero, or exceeds the 20-octet RFC 5280 cap.

nodes.name: linter/lints/rfc/lint_crl_has_valid_timestamps.go
nodes.summary: Boulder RFC 5280 lint: CRL thisUpdate, nextUpdate, and revocationDate fields must use GeneralizedTime before 2050 and UTCTime after, with correct encoding and no fractional seconds.

nodes.name: NewCrlHasValidTimestamps
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the CRL timestamp-encoding lint.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Walks thisUpdate/nextUpdate/revocationDate fields, dispatching each through lintTimestamp to enforce correct ASN.1 time choice and format per RFC 5280.

nodes.name: lintTimestamp
nodes.summary: Inspects a single DER-encoded time field, asserting UTCTime vs GeneralizedTime is chosen according to the RFC 5280 year 2050 boundary and that seconds are present and not fractional.

nodes.name: linter/lints/rfc/lint_crl_no_empty_revoked_certificates_list.go
nodes.summary: Boulder RFC 5280 lint: when the revokedCertificates field is present, it must not be the zero-length sequence.

nodes.name: NewCrlNoEmptyRevokedCertsList
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the non-empty-revokedCertificates lint.

nodes.name: linter/lints/rfc/lint_crl_via_pkimetal.go
nodes.summary: Boulder lint that POSTs candidate CRLs to a PKIMetal service and translates its findings into zlint results, mirroring the certificate variant.

nodes.name: NewCrlViaPKIMetal
nodes.summary: zlint constructor for the PKIMetal CRL lint.

nodes.name: Configure
nodes.summary: Returns the zlint Configurable hook that exposes PKIMetalConfig for the CRL variant.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Serializes the tbsCertList and delegates to the shared PKIMetal execute helper to run the remote CRL lint suite.

nodes.name: log/log.go
nodes.summary: Boulder's structured syslog-flavored logger: defines the Logger interface, singleton wiring via Get/Set, stdout+syslog writers, and the AUDIT-tagged log entrypoints (AuditInfo, AuditErr) whose checksummed output feeds WebTrust audit reports.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; uses log/syslog, crc32 LogLineChecksum to detect truncated audit lines, and clock.Clock for testable timestamps.

nodes.name: Logger
nodes.summary: Exported interface every Boulder service logs through, distinguishing ordinary levels (Err/Warning/Info/Debug) from audit-grade events (AuditInfo, AuditErr) that must reach the AUDIT syslog stream.

nodes.name: stdoutWriter
nodes.summary: Writer implementation that emits syslog-formatted lines to stdout/stderr with hostname/pid prefix, level filtering, and tty-aware color escape codes for local development.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Constructs an impl Logger that fans out to both syslog and stdout, wrapping the provided syslog.Writer in a bothWriter with configured level thresholds.

nodes.name: StdoutLogger
nodes.summary: Builds a stdout-only Logger used by one-shot commands and tests where connecting to syslog is unnecessary.

nodes.name: newStdoutWriter
nodes.summary: Creates a stdoutWriter seeded with the process prefix (getPrefix), real wall clock, and tty detection so logAtLevel can pick RFC3164 vs. color-enhanced formatting.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Lazy singleton bootstrap invoked via sync.Once from Get; dials the local syslog daemon as the AUDIT facility and registers a Logger that panics the process if syslog is unreachable.

nodes.name: Set
nodes.summary: Installs a Logger into the package-level singleton; warns (but does not fail) when replacing an already-initialized logger to keep test harnesses safe.

nodes.name: Get
nodes.summary: Returns the shared Logger, triggering initialize() on first call so Boulder services can obtain a working audit logger without explicit wiring.

nodes.name: LogLineChecksum
nodes.summary: Computes a CRC32 checksum of a log line and encodes it as base64-url so downstream tooling (log/validator) can detect dropped or truncated audit log entries.

nodes.name: logAtLevel
nodes.summary: Core formatting/dispatch for log writers: replaces newlines, prepends the checksum, and routes by syslog severity; bothWriter variant fans the same line to syslog and stdout while enforcing per-sink level thresholds.

nodes.name: AuditInfo
nodes.summary: Emits an INFO-severity record tagged with the [AUDIT] prefix so compliance pipelines (Splunk, WebTrust audit extracts) can filter certificate-issuance decisions.

nodes.name: AuditErr
nodes.summary: Emits an ERR-severity [AUDIT] record capturing a failure plus optional context object; the canonical hook for reporting issuance or revocation errors that must appear in WebTrust audit trails.

nodes.name: Err
nodes.summary: Writes a non-audit ERR-severity log line via the configured writer.

nodes.name: Errf
nodes.summary: printf-style variant of Err that formats the message before delegating to logAtLevel.

nodes.name: Warning
nodes.summary: Emits a WARNING-severity syslog record.

nodes.name: Warningf
nodes.summary: printf-style formatter wrapping Warning.

nodes.name: Info
nodes.summary: Emits an INFO-severity syslog record used for routine operational tracing.

nodes.name: Infof
nodes.summary: printf-style formatter wrapping Info.

nodes.name: InfoObject
nodes.summary: Encodes an arbitrary Go value via formatObj and logs it as INFO; falls back to logging the marshalling failure so non-audit diagnostics are never silently dropped.

nodes.name: Debug
nodes.summary: Emits a DEBUG-severity syslog record (typically filtered out in production).

nodes.name: Debugf
nodes.summary: printf-style formatter wrapping Debug.

nodes.name: formatObj
nodes.summary: Renders an arbitrary value as single-line JSON (HTML escaping off, trailing newline trimmed) for inclusion in audit lines; surfaces encoder errors so callers can log them rather than drop context.

nodes.name: log/mock.go
nodes.summary: In-memory Logger implementation used by Boulder's unit tests to capture syslog-formatted output, providing regex-based assertions on audit and non-audit log lines without dialing a real syslog daemon.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; serializes captures through a goroutine owning mockWriter.logged via channels for concurrency-safe reads.

nodes.name: Mock
nodes.summary: Test Logger interface extension that exposes GetAll/GetAllMatching/ExpectMatch/Clear helpers so tests can assert expected AUDIT lines were emitted.

nodes.name: WaitingMock
nodes.summary: Mock variant that blocks readers until a matching log line appears, supporting tests of asynchronous audit emissions.

nodes.name: UseMock
nodes.summary: Replaces the process-wide singleton logger with a fresh Mock via Set, enabling tests to capture AuditInfo/AuditErr output.

nodes.name: NewMock
nodes.summary: Factory for a Mock backed by a newMockWriter goroutine, returning a Logger that also satisfies the Mock assertion interface.

nodes.name: newMockWriter
nodes.summary: Spawns the goroutine that owns mockWriter.logged and mediates append/get/clear/close operations through select channels, ensuring tests observe a consistent snapshot of captured log lines.

nodes.name: GetAll
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of every log line captured so far by requesting it from the writer goroutine.

nodes.name: GetAllMatching
nodes.summary: Filters captured log lines by a user-supplied regular expression, the primary hook tests use to assert a specific AUDIT event was logged.

nodes.name: ExpectMatch
nodes.summary: Asserts exactly one captured log line matches the regex, returning a descriptive error listing all logged lines when the expectation fails.

nodes.name: Clear
nodes.summary: Drops all captured log lines so a single test can run multiple scenarios against the same Mock.

nodes.name: log/prod_prefix.go
nodes.summary: Production build tag that derives each log line's syslog prefix from the host's shortname plus the Boulder command (core.Command) and pid, matching the hostname/service/pid scheme expected by the audit log aggregator.
nodes.languageNotes: Go with !integration build tag; uses os.Hostname/os.Getpid.

nodes.name: getPrefix
nodes.summary: Builds the production syslog-line prefix '<hostshort> <command>[<pid>]' so audit records include enough context for WebTrust log correlation across hosts.

nodes.name: log/test_prefix.go
nodes.summary: Integration-test build tag providing a deterministic stub getPrefix so captured log output is stable across hosts in CI.
nodes.languageNotes: Go with integration build tag overriding prod_prefix.go.

nodes.name: log/validator/tail_logger.go
nodes.summary: Adapter that maps the hpcloud/tail library's standard-library Logger interface onto Boulder's structured Logger, so tail goroutines emit their diagnostics through the same audit-safe pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; wraps log.Logger methods Fatal/Panic/Print onto Err/Errf/Info so tail errors never bypass the syslog sink.

nodes.name: Fatal
nodes.summary: Forwards tail library Fatal messages to Boulder's Err logger (without exiting) so tail failures surface as regular error logs.

nodes.name: Fatalf
nodes.summary: printf-variant of Fatal that routes tail formatted failures into Boulder's Errf logger.

nodes.name: Fatalln
nodes.summary: Println-variant of Fatal for the tail library's stdlib Logger interface.

nodes.name: Panic
nodes.summary: Routes tail Panic messages into Err without triggering a real panic.

nodes.name: Panicf
nodes.summary: printf-variant of Panic for the tail logger interface.

nodes.name: Panicln
nodes.summary: Println-variant of Panic for the tail logger interface.

nodes.name: Print
nodes.summary: Forwards tail library Print messages to Boulder's Info logger.

nodes.name: Printf
nodes.summary: printf-variant of Print routing tail messages into Infof.

nodes.name: Println
nodes.summary: Println-variant of Print routing tail messages into Info.

nodes.name: log/validator/validator.go
nodes.summary: Log-validator daemon that tails Boulder's syslog output and re-verifies each line's LogLineChecksum, emitting a Prometheus counter (with ok/bad/invalid-checksum-length labels) so Splunk/WebTrust pipelines can prove no audit entries were lost or corrupted.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; uses hpcloud/tail for file following and promauto.NewCounterVec for per-file/per-result counts.

nodes.name: Validator
nodes.summary: Stateful log-tail validator holding the configured glob patterns, live tailers map, cancel handle for the monitor goroutine, and the lineCounter Prometheus metric reporting audit-line integrity.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Constructs a Validator, registers its per-(filename,result) counter with the provided Prometheus registry, and launches the monitor goroutine that discovers matching log files.

nodes.name: pollPaths
nodes.summary: Expands configured glob patterns and starts a new tail plus tailValidate goroutine for any freshly appearing audit log file, so rotated-in files are validated without restarting the daemon.

nodes.name: monitor
nodes.summary: Periodic driver that repeatedly calls pollPaths until the context is cancelled, reacting to log rotation events on a short timer.

nodes.name: tailValidate
nodes.summary: Consumes lines from a tail.TailFile channel, runs each through lineValid, and increments the lineCounter with labels ok/bad/invalid-checksum-length; rate-limits error logging so a single corrupted file cannot flood syslog.

nodes.name: Shutdown
nodes.summary: Cancels the monitor goroutine and stops/cleans every active tailer, used when the validator service is gracefully draining.

nodes.name: lineValid
nodes.summary: Parses a syslog line, extracts the trailing base64 checksum, recomputes LogLineChecksum over the remaining content, and returns distinguishable errors for short checksums vs. actual mismatches so the caller can route to the right Prometheus label.

nodes.name: ValidateFile
nodes.summary: Utility entrypoint that reads an entire log file, runs lineValid over every line, prints offending lines to stderr, and returns an error if any invalid line was found; used by the log-validator CLI for ad-hoc audits.

nodes.name: metrics/measured_http/http.go
nodes.summary: HTTP middleware that wraps a ServeMux with OpenTelemetry tracing and Prometheus latency/in-flight metrics, used by WFE/OCSP/CRL front-ends to expose per-endpoint request histograms and gauges.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; delegates to otelhttp.NewHandler for tracing and promauto.NewHistogramVec/NewGaugeVec for metrics.

nodes.name: MeasuredHandler
nodes.summary: http.Handler that records request latency by endpoint/method/status plus an in-flight-requests gauge; the Prometheus-facing wrapper Boulder plugs under any serveMux.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Registers the response-time histogram and in-flight gauge with the supplied Prometheus registry and returns an http.Handler that also emits OTel spans for each request.

nodes.name: ServeHTTP
nodes.summary: Resolves the matched mux pattern, bumps the in-flight gauge, invokes the sub-handler, and records the observed status code and latency into the Prometheus histogram labelled by endpoint/method/code.

nodes.name: WriteHeader
nodes.summary: responseWriterWithStatus override that captures the final HTTP status code so ServeHTTP can include it as a Prometheus label.

nodes.name: Write
nodes.summary: responseWriterWithStatus override that defaults the captured code to 200 when a handler writes a body without explicitly calling WriteHeader.

nodes.name: metrics/scope.go
nodes.summary: Defines a Boulder-wide no-op prometheus.Registerer used in tests and short-lived commands that do not expose a /metrics endpoint, so code that assumes a registry is always present can run without panicking.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; satisfies prometheus.Registerer with empty MustRegister/Register/Unregister implementations.

nodes.name: MustRegister
nodes.summary: No-op prometheus.Registerer method; discards all Collectors passed in so code under test can call it without side effects.

nodes.name: Register
nodes.summary: No-op prometheus.Registerer.Register that returns a nil error, letting callers register metrics without needing a real registry.

nodes.name: Unregister
nodes.summary: No-op prometheus.Registerer.Unregister stub returning false, completing the Registerer interface for the noop scope.

nodes.name: must/must.go
nodes.summary: Boulder test helper that panics on non-nil error so callers can do one-line setup like must.Do(uuid.Parse(x)); used sparingly outside of tests to crash early on impossible init errors.
nodes.languageNotes: Go generic function parameterized on the success value T; returns T and re-panics on err.

nodes.name: Do
nodes.summary: Returns t unchanged when err is nil, otherwise panics with err; used to collapse (value, error) pairs into a single expression in Boulder tests and init paths.

nodes.name: nonce/nonce.go
nodes.summary: Boulder's JWS anti-replay nonce service: generates AES-GCM authenticated nonces keyed by an HMAC-derived prefix, tracks the sliding window of redeemed counters in a heap to reject replays, and exposes gRPC Nonce/Redeem RPCs plus the Getter/Redeemer client wrappers consumed by wfe2.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; uses crypto/aes+cipher.GCM for authenticated encryption of a monotonic counter, container/heap of used counters for gc, prometheus metrics for nonce age/latency, and hmac+sha256 to derive a stable 4-char per-instance prefix from the gRPC address.

nodes.name: NonceService
nodes.summary: Central struct that issues and validates Boulder nonces: holds the GCM cipher, latest/earliest counters, a used-heap bounded by maxUsed for replay detection, the per-instance 4-char prefix, and the nonce_* Prometheus counters.

nodes.name: Getter
nodes.summary: gRPC client interface exposing only the Nonce RPC; wfe2 uses this to fetch fresh nonces from remote nonce servers without coupling to the full NonceService struct.

nodes.name: Redeemer
nodes.summary: gRPC client interface exposing only the Redeem RPC; wfe2 routes ACME replay-nonce header validation through this so any nonce-service instance with the matching prefix can verify.

nodes.name: PrefixCtxKey
nodes.summary: Context key type used to propagate the 4-character nonce prefix through gRPC metadata so WFE can route a Redeem call to the specific backend that issued it.

nodes.name: HMACKeyCtxKey
nodes.summary: Context key type carrying the shared HMAC key used by DerivePrefix so clients and servers agree on the per-address nonce prefix.

nodes.name: DerivePrefix
nodes.summary: Returns a deterministic 4-character base64url prefix by HMAC-SHA256-ing a nonce backend's gRPC address under the shared key, letting WFE identify which backend must redeem a given nonce.

nodes.name: NewNonceService
nodes.summary: Constructs a NonceService: validates the 4-char base64url prefix, generates a random AES key, builds the GCM cipher, registers the nonce_* Prometheus metrics, and initializes the counter heap used to detect replays.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Serializes a uint64 counter into a 12-byte GCM nonce and returns the prefix + base64url(ciphertext||tag) string issued to ACME clients as Replay-Nonce.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Base64url-decodes the body of a nonce, runs GCM Open, and returns the embedded counter; errors on wrong length, tag mismatch, or bad encoding so forged nonces are rejected.

nodes.name: valid
nodes.summary: Core replay check: decrypts the nonce, confirms the counter is within the sliding window bounded by earliest/latest, has not already been redeemed per the used-heap, then records Prometheus metrics and evicts the oldest counter when the heap hits maxUsed.

nodes.name: Redeem
nodes.summary: gRPC handler that takes a NonceMessage, strips the prefix, calls valid under the mutex, and returns a ValidMessage so WFE2 can accept or reject the JWS.

nodes.name: Nonce
nodes.summary: gRPC handler that increments the counter under the mutex, encrypts it, and returns the resulting Replay-Nonce string to WFE2 for inclusion in ACME response headers.

nodes.name: NewGetter
nodes.summary: Wraps a grpc.ClientConnInterface as a Getter client so WFE2 can request new nonces from the nonce-service backends.

nodes.name: NewRedeemer
nodes.summary: Wraps a grpc.ClientConnInterface as a Redeemer client so WFE2 can route a Redeem call to the specific nonce-service that matches the nonce prefix.

nodes.name: nonce/proto/nonce.proto
nodes.summary: gRPC service definition for Boulder's nonce backend: declares NonceService with Nonce()/Redeem() RPCs plus the NonceMessage/ValidMessage wire types consumed by wfe2 for ACME replay-nonce handling.
nodes.languageNotes: proto3; go_package github.com/letsencrypt/boulder/nonce/proto; imports google/protobuf/empty.proto.

nodes.name: observer/mon_conf.go
nodes.summary: Per-monitor YAML config block for Boulder's observer: holds Period + prober Kind + raw Settings, validates the polling period, and dispatches to the registered Configurer.UnmarshalSettings/MakeProber to build a runnable monitor.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; uses config.Duration and delegates to observer/probers.GetConfigurer for prober-plugin lookup.

nodes.name: MonConf
nodes.summary: Struct deserialized from each entry under observer.monitors in YAML: Period, Kind (probe type), and Settings (raw sub-config passed to the Configurer for that Kind).

nodes.name: makeMonitor
nodes.summary: Given a validated MonConf, instantiates the configured prober via its Configurer, registers its Prometheus metrics, and returns a monitor ready to be polled on Period.

nodes.name: observer/monitor.go
nodes.summary: Internal monitor wrapper that runs a single configured Prober on a ticker, records latency + success/failure counters, and logs probe errors through Boulder's blog.Logger.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; goroutine per monitor with time.Ticker; metrics exposed via prometheus Histogram and Counter registered by the Configurer.

nodes.name: monitor
