nodes.summary: Unexported struct pairing a Prober with its polling period, logger, and prometheus collectors; produced by MonConf.makeMonitor and started by Observer.Start.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Runs the monitor loop: every Period calls Prober.Probe, records duration in the histogram keyed by success and observed response, and logs failures so external alerting can notice silent regressions in the Let's Encrypt production chain.

nodes.name: observer/obs_conf.go
nodes.summary: Top-level YAML config for the boulder-observer binary: debug addr, syslog, timeout, and the slice of MonConfs; MakeObserver validates every entry and assembles a runnable Observer.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; wires cmd.ServiceConfig/SyslogConfig and defers to MonConf.makeMonitor for each monitor entry.

nodes.name: ObsConf
nodes.summary: Observer binary configuration: Syslog, DebugAddr, global Timeout, Buckets (histogram edges), and MonConfs list; consumed by MakeObserver to produce the running service.

nodes.name: makeMonitors
nodes.summary: Iterates every MonConf, calls its makeMonitor, accumulates non-fatal validation errors so the whole config is reported at once, and fails fast only when zero valid monitors remain.

nodes.name: MakeObserver
nodes.summary: Entry point used by cmd/boulder-observer: sets up logger, prometheus registry, HTTP debug server, builds all monitors from ObsConf, and returns an Observer that Start() will run.

nodes.name: observer/obsclient/obsclient.go
nodes.summary: Shared HTTP client helper used by CRL/HTTP/TLS probers: builds a net/http.Client with a fixed Boulder observer User-Agent and a custom Dialer so probe requests are identifiable in upstream logs.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; wraps net/http plus a custom net.Dialer timeout-aware transport used by observer probers.

nodes.name: Client
nodes.summary: Returns a shared http.Client preconfigured with the observer User-Agent so every probe request is traceable back to Boulder's synthetic monitoring.

nodes.name: Dialer
nodes.summary: Returns the net.Dialer the observer uses for outbound probe connections with a tight keep-alive/timeout tuned for synthetic monitoring.

nodes.name: observer/observer.go
nodes.summary: Runtime container for the boulder-observer daemon: holds the logger, prometheus registry, timeout, and the list of active monitors produced by ObsConf.MakeObserver.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; Start() launches one goroutine per monitor and blocks.

nodes.name: Observer
nodes.summary: Top-level observer instance returned by MakeObserver; bundles logger, metrics registry, timeout, and monitors and exposes Start to spawn all monitor goroutines.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Launches every configured monitor on its own goroutine and blocks forever so the boulder-observer process stays alive under systemd/k8s supervision.

nodes.name: observer/probers/aia/aia.go
nodes.summary: Boulder observer AIA prober: fetches the Authority Information Access caIssuers URL from an end-entity cert, verifies the returned bytes parse as a DER certificate, and emits latency plus reason-code metrics for alerting on broken AIA endpoints in the Let's Encrypt chain.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; uses crypto/x509 and net/http; kind string feeds the observer_monitors Prometheus labels.

nodes.name: AIAProbe
nodes.summary: Prober implementation for an AIA URL: holds the URL to fetch, the configured userAgent, and the prometheus reason-code counter vector updated on every probe.

nodes.name: Probe
nodes.summary: Performs the AIA HTTP GET, classifies the outcome into reason codes (http-error, parse-error, ok, ...), increments the reason counter, and returns the duration observed by the monitor histogram.

nodes.name: observer/probers/aia/aia_conf.go
nodes.summary: Configurer for the AIA prober: strict-yaml unmarshals {url, user_agent}, validates the URL, registers the aia_reason counter with the observer Prometheus registry, and returns a ready AIAProbe.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; init() registers this Configurer with observer/probers.Register under kind "AIA".

nodes.name: AIAConf
nodes.summary: YAML settings block for an AIA monitor: URL to fetch and optional user_agent string; implements the probers.Configurer interface.

nodes.name: MakeProber
nodes.summary: Validates the AIA URL, defaults the user-agent, captures the aia_reason counter from the Prometheus collectors, and returns a fully-wired AIAProbe.

nodes.name: Instrument
nodes.summary: Returns the aia-prober-specific Prometheus collectors (reason counter) that MakeMonitor registers so each probe run can emit labelled outcomes.

nodes.name: observer/probers/ccadb/ccadb.go
nodes.summary: CCADB prober: downloads the Common CA Database all-certificate-records CSV, extracts every intermediate's CRL Distribution Point, and probes each CRL with crl/checker so Boulder can alert on revocation data that violates CABF/Mozilla requirements.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; uses crl/checker, crl/idp and strictyaml; CSV shape is pinned so a schema drift at CCADB surfaces as a probe error.

nodes.name: CCADBConf
nodes.summary: YAML configurer for the CCADB prober: optional decade filter (which intermediates to audit) and user agent override; implements probers.Configurer.

nodes.name: CCADBProber
nodes.summary: Prober that pulls the CCADB intermediates CSV, filters by decade of NotAfter, fetches each CRL, and runs crl/checker.Validate against it to detect expired/malformed CRLs across the WebPKI.

nodes.name: MakeProber
nodes.summary: Builds a CCADBProber from CCADBConf: resolves collectors, pins the CCADB CSV URL, wires the decade filter, and captures the http client for later probe rounds.

nodes.name: Probe
nodes.summary: Full probe round: downloads the CCADB CSV, parses intermediates, iterates CRL URLs, runs checkCRL against each, and records per-CRL failure reasons in the ccadb prometheus vectors.

nodes.name: checkCRL
nodes.summary: Fetches a single CRL URL, parses the CRL DER, and runs crl/checker.Validate to assert it satisfies CABF lintable invariants (nextUpdate, IDP presence, etc.).

nodes.name: getCSV
nodes.summary: HTTP-GETs the CCADB all-certificate-records CSV with the observer user-agent and retry policy, returning the raw bytes for the intermediates parser.

nodes.name: getAllIntermediates
nodes.summary: Parses the CCADB CSV header and rows into a typed record slice; stable column order is asserted so schema changes at Mozilla surface as a probe failure rather than silent skew.

nodes.name: getDecadeIntermediates
nodes.summary: Filters parsed CCADB records down to intermediates whose NotAfter lies in the configured decade bucket so one probe run doesn't try to validate thousands of CRLs.

nodes.name: getCRLURLs
nodes.summary: For a given intermediate extracts the CRL Distribution Point URLs from the CCADB row and the cert's crlDistributionPoints extension, de-duplicating for the probe loop.

nodes.name: observer/probers/ccadb/retryhttp.go
nodes.summary: Bounded HTTP retry helper shared inside the CCADB prober: issues the request, retries on 5xx/transport errors with backoff, and caps the body length so a misbehaving CA can't exhaust the observer process.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; internal only, not exported.

nodes.name: observer/probers/crl/crl.go
nodes.summary: CRL prober: fetches a configured CRL URL, parses it, extracts the IDP extension, and records thisUpdate/nextUpdate age plus entry count so Boulder alerts on stalled or oversized CRLs in its own hierarchy.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; uses crl/idp and observer/obsclient HTTP client.

nodes.name: CRLProbe
nodes.summary: Prober implementation targeting a single CRL URL; carries prometheus gauges for nextUpdate age and entry count that MakeProber wired from Instrument().

nodes.name: Probe
nodes.summary: Downloads the CRL, parses it, reads the IssuingDistributionPoint extension, and updates the three crl_* gauges; returns ok/false so the monitor histogram tags the outcome.

nodes.name: observer/probers/crl/crl_conf.go
nodes.summary: Configurer for the CRL prober: strict-yaml unmarshals {url, partitioned, ...}, validates the URL scheme, registers the crl_* gauges, and produces a CRLProbe.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; init() registers Configurer under kind "CRL".

nodes.name: CRLConf
nodes.summary: YAML settings for the CRL prober: URL and partitioned flag (whether to tolerate IDPs carving up the revocation set).

nodes.name: MakeProber
nodes.summary: Validates the configured URL and constructs a CRLProbe tied to the caller-provided gauge vectors.

nodes.name: Instrument
nodes.summary: Builds the CRL prober's Prometheus collectors (next-update age, this-update age, entry count) so the monitor registers them alongside the standard observer metrics.

nodes.name: observer/probers/dns/dns.go
nodes.summary: DNS prober: issues a configured query type (A, AAAA, CAA, ...) against a specific resolver using udp or tcp and reports whether the returned rcode matches the expected list so Boulder can alert on resolver regressions that would break ACME DNS-01.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; uses github.com/miekg/dns for the raw query.

nodes.name: DNSProbe
nodes.summary: Prober implementation that carries the resolver address, query target, qtype, proto, and list of acceptable rcodes for a single synthetic DNS check.

nodes.name: Probe
nodes.summary: Executes the DNS query via miekg/dns, checks the rcode against the allowed set, and returns success + duration for the observer histogram.

nodes.name: observer/probers/dns/dns_conf.go
nodes.summary: Configurer for the DNS prober: validates server host:port, proto (udp/tcp), qtype, and query name from strict-yaml, then returns a DNSProbe; rejects unknown qtypes so misconfigured monitors fail at startup.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; init() registers Configurer under kind "DNS".

nodes.name: DNSConf
nodes.summary: YAML settings for the DNS prober: server, proto, recurse flag, query target, qtype, and acceptable rcodes.

nodes.name: MakeProber
nodes.summary: Runs every DNSConf validator, then assembles a DNSProbe with the normalized resolver address and qtype ready for Probe().

nodes.name: observer/probers/http/http.go
nodes.summary: HTTP prober: issues a GET against a configured URL with the observer's http.Client and checks the response status against an allow-list so Boulder alerts on outages of its own (or upstream) HTTP endpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; uses observer/obsclient for the shared User-Agent.

nodes.name: HTTPProbe
nodes.summary: Prober implementation holding the URL, acceptable rcodes, and insecure flag that Probe consults on each run.

nodes.name: Probe
nodes.summary: Performs the HTTP GET through obsclient.Client, compares the response status to the allowed list, and returns success + status-code label for the observer histogram.

nodes.name: observer/probers/http/http_conf.go
nodes.summary: Configurer for the HTTP prober: validates URL and the rcodes list from strict-yaml and registers under kind "HTTP" with observer/probers.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; init() calls probers.Register.

nodes.name: HTTPConf
nodes.summary: YAML settings for the HTTP prober: URL, rcodes allow-list, insecure flag (skip TLS verification), and useragent override.

nodes.name: MakeProber
nodes.summary: Validates the URL and rcodes, then returns an HTTPProbe with the allow-list converted to an int set the prober can compare cheaply.

nodes.name: observer/probers/mock/mock_conf.go
nodes.summary: Test-only Configurer registered under kind "MockConf" that lets observer unit tests exercise the Configurer registry and monitor wiring without hitting a real prober.

nodes.name: MockConfigurer
nodes.summary: Stub Configurer returning a MockProber; used by observer/probers test harness to assert registration and settings marshalling.

nodes.name: observer/probers/mock/mock_prober.go
nodes.summary: Test-only Prober that returns a fixed success/duration so monitor/scheduler tests can run deterministically.

nodes.name: MockProber
nodes.summary: Stub Prober with preset return values used only in observer unit tests.

nodes.name: observer/probers/prober.go
nodes.summary: Plugin interface + registry for Boulder's observer probers: defines Prober (Probe/Name/Kind) and Configurer (YAML unmarshal/MakeProber/Instrument), plus the global kind->Configurer map each prober package populates via init().
nodes.languageNotes: Go; Register panics on duplicate kind so test binaries fail loudly if two packages collide.

nodes.name: Prober
nodes.summary: Interface each concrete prober (AIA, CRL, DNS, HTTP, TLS, CCADB) implements: Probe runs the check, Name/Kind label the prometheus metrics.

nodes.name: Configurer
nodes.summary: Interface each prober's config type implements: UnmarshalSettings turns raw YAML into a typed struct, MakeProber validates and builds the Prober, Instrument returns the prober-specific Prometheus collectors.

nodes.name: GetConfigurer
nodes.summary: Looks up the Configurer previously Registered under a given kind (normalized to lowercase) so MonConf can dispatch to the right plugin at runtime.

nodes.name: Register
nodes.summary: Called from each prober package's init() to publish its Configurer under a kind string; panics on duplicate registration so build-time wiring mistakes fail immediately.

nodes.name: observer/probers/tls/tls.go
nodes.summary: TLS prober: dials a host, validates the chain against the system pool, distinguishes expired vs unexpired probe modes, and checks OCSP + CRL revocation status; drives prometheus reason counters so Boulder alerts on regressions in its production TLS endpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; uses crypto/tls, crypto/ocsp, crypto/x509; expired-mode intentionally connects to a known-expired host to verify the observer still fails closed.

nodes.name: TLSProbe
nodes.summary: Prober implementation holding hostname, expected root CN, response mode (expired/unexpired), and the TLS-specific Prometheus reason counter vector.

nodes.name: checkOCSP
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses the OCSP response for the leaf, verifies its signature under the issuer, and classifies the result (good/revoked/unknown/error) so TLSProbe can surface revocation regressions.

nodes.name: checkCRL
nodes.summary: Downloads the CRL referenced by the leaf's CDP, parses it, verifies the issuer signature, and checks whether the leaf's serial is present so TLSProbe can detect broken CRL publication.

nodes.name: probeExpired
nodes.summary: Expired-cert probe mode: connects with InsecureSkipVerify, asserts the chain is in fact expired (NotAfter in the past), and records reason metrics; fails if the server rotated off of the known-expired cert.

nodes.name: probeUnexpired
nodes.summary: Standard probe mode: performs full verified TLS handshake, confirms the expected root, and drives checkOCSP/checkCRL so revoked or about-to-expire certs raise alerts.

nodes.name: Probe
nodes.summary: Public entrypoint invoked by the monitor loop: dispatches to probeExpired or probeUnexpired based on configured response mode and returns success/response-label for the observer histogram.

nodes.name: observer/probers/tls/tls_conf.go
nodes.summary: Configurer for the TLS prober: validates hostname, root CN, and response mode (expired/unexpired) from strict-yaml, registers the tls_reason counter, and returns a ready TLSProbe.
nodes.languageNotes: Go; init() calls probers.Register under kind "TLS".

nodes.name: TLSConf
nodes.summary: YAML settings for the TLS prober: hostname, expected root CN, and response mode; the mode selects expired vs unexpired probe logic.

nodes.name: MakeProber
nodes.summary: Validates hostname and response mode, resolves the expected root cert, captures the tls_reason counter, and returns a TLSProbe ready for scheduled probing.

nodes.name: Instrument
nodes.summary: Returns the TLS prober's Prometheus collectors (tls_reason counter plus chain-age gauges) so the monitor registers them alongside the observer default collectors.

nodes.name: pkcs11helpers/helpers.go
nodes.summary: PKCS#11 (HSM) helper routines: session setup, key discovery, RSA/ECDSA public key extraction, and signing, used by Boulder's CA/ceremony tooling when operating against an HSM. Provides a crypto.Signer adapter (x509Signer) and a MockCtx for tests.

nodes.name: PKCtx
nodes.summary: Interface abstracting the subset of pkcs11.Ctx methods Boulder uses (GenerateKeyPair, SignInit, Sign, FindObjects*, etc.), enabling MockCtx substitution in tests.

nodes.name: Session
nodes.summary: Wraps a PKCS#11 module plus an open session handle; primary entry point for all HSM operations Boulder performs (key lookup, attribute fetch, signing).

nodes.name: x509Signer
nodes.summary: crypto.Signer implementation backed by an HSM object handle; used so Boulder can pass an HSM-resident key into x509.CreateCertificate and similar APIs.

nodes.name: MockCtx
nodes.summary: Function-valued stub implementing PKCtx for unit tests, letting callers override each HSM method individually.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Opens a PKCS#11 module, opens a session on the given slot, and logs in with the given PIN; the standard bootstrap used by ceremony and CA signing tools.

nodes.name: getPublicKeyID
nodes.summary: Finds an HSM public-key object matching an in-memory RSA or ECDSA public key by building the correct PKCS#11 attribute template, then returns its CKA_ID; used to locate the matching private key.

nodes.name: GetRSAPublicKey
nodes.summary: Reads CKA_MODULUS and CKA_PUBLIC_EXPONENT from an HSM object and reconstructs an *rsa.PublicKey for use in Go crypto code paths.

nodes.name: GetECDSAPublicKey
nodes.summary: Reads CKA_EC_PARAMS and CKA_EC_POINT, identifies the named curve (P-256/P-384), and decodes the point into an *ecdsa.PublicKey.

nodes.name: Session.Sign
nodes.summary: Signs a digest via PKCS#11: selects RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 (with the correct DigestInfo prefix) or ECDSA mechanism based on keyType and hash, then calls SignInit+Sign.

nodes.name: FindObject
nodes.summary: Runs a PKCS#11 FindObjectsInit/FindObjects/FindObjectsFinal cycle against a template and requires exactly one match, returning an error if zero or multiple objects are found.

nodes.name: x509Signer.Sign
nodes.summary: crypto.Signer.Sign shim: delegates to Session.Sign and, for ECDSA, wraps (r, s) in ASN.1 sequence form as Go's x509 machinery expects.

nodes.name: NewSigner
nodes.summary: Constructs an x509Signer by locating the HSM public and private key objects for a given label/public key pair; the canonical way Boulder hands an HSM key to Go's crypto packages.

nodes.name: policy/pa.go
nodes.summary: Policy Authority implementation. Validates identifiers (DNS, IP, email) for syntactic and PSL correctness, enforces exact/wildcard/high-risk/admin-prefix blocklists from the hot-reloadable policy YAML, and selects allowed ACME challenge types per identifier.

nodes.name: AuthorityImpl
nodes.summary: Concrete PolicyAuthority: holds domain/FQDN/wildcard/IP-prefix blocklists guarded by a RWMutex plus the enabled challenge and identifier sets; consumed by RA and WFE.

nodes.name: blockedIdentsPolicy
nodes.summary: YAML schema for the hostname/IP blocklist file (ExactBlockedNames, HighRiskBlockedNames, AdminBlockedNames, AdminBlockedPrefixes).

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Constructs an AuthorityImpl with the given enabled identifier types and challenge types, rejecting construction if either set is empty.

nodes.name: LoadIdentPolicyFile
nodes.summary: Reads and SHA-256-logs the blocklist YAML, parses it in strict mode, and swaps the loaded blocklists atomically under the mutex; called on startup and by reloader.

nodes.name: processIdentPolicy
nodes.summary: Transforms the parsed blocklist YAML into runtime maps and netip prefix lists, splitting entries by identifier type (DNS vs IP) and validating CIDR blocks.

nodes.name: validNonWildcardDomain
nodes.summary: Enforces Boulder's DNS name rules: allowed character set, label length and count, TLD checks against IANA PSL, Unicode NFC/IDNA restrictions, and public-suffix rejection.

nodes.name: ValidDomain
nodes.summary: Public wrapper validating a domain with at most one leading '*.' wildcard label, rejecting wildcard-on-public-suffix, and delegating to validNonWildcardDomain for the base.

nodes.name: ValidIP
nodes.summary: Validates an IP-address identifier: requires RFC 5952 canonical form, rejects zones, and blocks reserved/bogon ranges via iana.IsReservedAddr.

nodes.name: ValidEmail
nodes.summary: Validates a contact email address syntactically and checks that the domain part would itself be a valid non-wildcard domain under Boulder's rules.

nodes.name: WillingToIssue
nodes.summary: Top-level gate called by the RA: confirms each identifier is well-formed, is of an enabled type, and does not hit the wildcard or general blocklists; aggregates per-identifier errors into one RejectedIdentifier error.

nodes.name: WellFormedIdentifiers
nodes.summary: Checks each identifier for syntactic validity by type (DNS or IP), rejecting unknown types, and returns a combined sub-error if any fail.

nodes.name: combineSubErrors
nodes.summary: Collapses a list of per-identifier sub-errors into a single BoulderError of type RejectedIdentifier with a human-readable aggregated detail string.

nodes.name: checkBlocklists
nodes.summary: Applies domain blocklist (walking parent labels), exact FQDN blocklist, admin-name/admin-prefix lists, and IP-prefix blocklists against a single identifier; returns an error on match.

nodes.name: checkWildcardBlocklist
nodes.summary: Checks a wildcard base domain against the wildcard FQDN blocklist and the parent-domain blocklist.

nodes.name: ChallengeTypesFor
nodes.summary: Returns the set of ACME challenge types allowed for a given identifier: HTTP-01/TLS-ALPN-01/DNS-01 (plus optional DNS-ACCOUNT-01) for DNS, HTTP-01/TLS-ALPN-01 for IP, with wildcard-only-DNS-01 enforcement.

nodes.name: CheckAuthzChallenges
nodes.summary: Verifies a stored authorization still satisfies current policy: its challenge type is still enabled and still legal for the authorization's identifier.

nodes.name: precert/corr.go
nodes.summary: Precertificate/final-certificate correspondence checker. Given DER of a precert and its final cert, asserts they describe the same certificate except that the final cert has the SCT-list extension where the precert had the CT poison extension, matching Boulder's audit invariant.

nodes.name: Correspond
nodes.summary: Entry point: parses both TBSCertificate DER blobs with cryptobyte, walks their extension sequences in lockstep skipping CT poison in the precert and SCT list in the final cert, and requires every other field to be byte-identical.

nodes.name: extensionParser
nodes.summary: Iterator over a DER Extensions sequence that transparently skips and counts extensions matching a given OID (used to elide CT poison and SCT-list extensions during comparison).

nodes.name: extensionParser.Next
nodes.summary: Returns the next extension in the sequence or nil at end of input; increments skipped and recurses when the current extension's OID matches skippableOID.

nodes.name: unwrapExtensions
nodes.summary: Peels the explicit [3] wrapper and outer SEQUENCE off a TBSCertificate 'extensions' field, returning the inner bytes of the Extensions SEQUENCE.

nodes.name: readIdenticalElement
nodes.summary: Reads one ASN.1 element from each of two cryptobyte.String cursors and fails if their tags or contents differ; the primitive used to enforce field-for-field equality.

nodes.name: tbsDERFromCertDER
nodes.summary: Strips the outer Certificate SEQUENCE to expose TBSCertificate bytes from a full DER-encoded certificate.

nodes.name: salesforce/cache.go
nodes.summary: SHA-256-hashed LRU cache of subscriber email addresses used by Boulder's salesforce exporter to deduplicate contact submissions to Pardot; exposes Seen/Remove/StoreIfAbsent with a Prometheus counter keyed by hit/miss status.

nodes.name: EmailCache
nodes.summary: Mutex-guarded LRU cache plus a Prometheus CounterVec that tracks email hashes already sent to Salesforce so the exporter avoids duplicate Pardot contact uploads.

nodes.name: NewHashedEmailCache
nodes.summary: Builds an EmailCache with the given LRU capacity and a Prometheus email_cache_requests CounterVec for hit/miss accounting.

nodes.name: Seen
nodes.summary: Looks up a SHA-256 hash of an email in the LRU and increments the hit or miss counter; used by the salesforce exporter to skip recently-sent addresses.

nodes.name: Remove
nodes.summary: Evicts a single hashed email from the LRU so a subsequent export attempt will be retried.

nodes.name: StoreIfAbsent
nodes.summary: Atomically checks the cache and, if the hashed email is absent, stores it; returns whether the caller should perform the outbound Salesforce send.

nodes.name: salesforce/email/proto/emailexporter.proto
nodes.summary: Deprecated gRPC schema for the email.Exporter service (SendContacts, SendCase) that predates salesforce.Exporter; kept in sync during the migration tracked by Boulder issue #8410.

nodes.name: salesforce/exporter.go
nodes.summary: Implements the salesforce.Exporter gRPC server: a bounded LIFO queue of subscriber emails drained by a pool of workers that rate-limit Pardot SendContact calls and forward rate-limit-override support cases (SendCase) to Salesforce.

nodes.name: ExporterImpl
nodes.summary: gRPC server struct wiring an EmailCache, rate limiter, Salesforce client, worker pool and metrics so Boulder can batch subscriber email exports to Pardot and create Salesforce support cases for rate-limit override requests from the SFE.

nodes.name: NewExporterImpl
nodes.summary: Constructs an ExporterImpl with a per-day rate limiter, worker concurrency bound, Prometheus counters for handled emails and Pardot/case errors, and the shared EmailCache used to dedupe contacts.

nodes.name: SendContacts
nodes.summary: gRPC entry point that enqueues new subscriber emails for asynchronous upload to Pardot; rejects requests with ErrQueueFull when the bounded queue is saturated.

nodes.name: SendCase
nodes.summary: gRPC entry point used by the SFE to forward a rate-limit override request (subject, description, contact email, account ID, rate-limit name/tier) to Salesforce as a support Case.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Main worker loop that pops emails LIFO from the queue under the global rate limiter, invokes SalesforceClient.SendContact, and updates hit/error/handled metrics; exits cleanly when Drain signals shutdown.

nodes.name: salesforce/pardot.go
nodes.summary: HTTP client for Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot): manages OAuth2 token refresh, submits prospect upserts for subscriber emails, and creates Salesforce support Cases for rate-limit override requests raised via the SFE.

nodes.name: SalesforceClient
nodes.summary: Interface that the salesforce ExporterImpl depends on: SendContact for Pardot prospect upserts and SendCase for Salesforce support cases, so tests can substitute a fake client.

nodes.name: SalesforceClientImpl
nodes.summary: Production SalesforceClient that holds OAuth2 credentials, business unit/org IDs, cached access token, and HTTP clients for Pardot and the core Salesforce REST API.

nodes.name: Case
nodes.summary: JSON payload for Salesforce Case creation carrying the subscriber's override request context (subject, description, contact email, account ID, rate-limit name/tier, use case) that feeds LE's support workflow.

nodes.name: NewSalesforceClientImpl
nodes.summary: Builds a SalesforceClientImpl from OAuth2 and endpoint configuration, validating required fields before returning the client used by the salesforce exporter.

nodes.name: updateToken
nodes.summary: Refreshes the cached Salesforce OAuth2 access token using client-credentials grant against the configured token endpoint; serialized via mutex so concurrent senders share one token.

nodes.name: SendContact
nodes.summary: Upserts a subscriber email as a Pardot prospect via the v5 Pardot API, refreshing the OAuth token on 401 and surfacing Pardot error bodies so the exporter can record structured metrics.

nodes.name: SendCase
nodes.summary: Creates a Salesforce Case via the REST API for an SFE-submitted rate-limit override request, retrying once after a token refresh on 401 and returning the Salesforce error body on failure.

nodes.name: salesforce/proto/exporter.proto
nodes.summary: gRPC schema for the salesforce.Exporter service (SendContacts, SendCase) that replaces the deprecated email.Exporter and is consumed by the WFE/SFE to export subscriber emails and submit override-request cases.

nodes.summary: Request body for the SFE per-field validate-field JSON endpoint (rate-limit name, field name, value) used by the browser as the subscriber types.

nodes.name: validationResponse
nodes.summary: Response body returned to the SFE browser-side form telling it whether a field value is valid and, if not, the user-visible error.

nodes.summary: Full submission payload from the SFE override request form, holding every user-entered field the handler validates, files to Zendesk, and optionally auto-applies via the RA.

nodes.summary: Files a subscriber override request as a Zendesk ticket with structured custom fields (rate limit name, tier, account URI, etc.) so LE support can triage manual approvals.

nodes.summary: Per-field validator dispatched from the live validate-field endpoint and from the final submit handler: enforces rules for account URI, registered domain, IP address, tier, organization, use case, email and agreement checkboxes.

nodes.summary: Factory returning an http.HandlerFunc that renders the SFE override request form for a specific rate limit.

nodes.name: overrideRequestHandler
nodes.summary: Top-level GET handler that renders the SFE override request form by assembling the appropriate Form and template data for the selected rate-limit resource.

nodes.summary: POST endpoint that re-validates every field of an overrideRequest, creates a Zendesk ticket, and for auto-approvable tiers applies the override via the RA and exports a Salesforce case; renders the appropriate success template.

nodes.name: sfe/overridesimporter.go
nodes.summary: Background importer that polls Zendesk for approved override-request tickets and applies them against the RegistrationAuthority's rate-limit override API, transitioning tickets back to pending with a status comment once processed.

nodes.name: OverridesImporter
nodes.summary: Worker that periodically polls Zendesk for approved override tickets, shards them by ProcessMode (all/even/odd) so multiple instances can run side-by-side, and calls the RA to apply the change.

nodes.name: NewOverridesImporter
nodes.summary: Constructs an OverridesImporter after validating the polling interval and wiring the Zendesk client and RegistrationAuthority dependencies.

nodes.summary: Runs the importer ticker loop until the context is cancelled, calling tick on each interval to process any newly approved Zendesk override tickets.

nodes.summary: Queries Zendesk for approved tickets matching the shard, then invokes processTicket for each so the RA receives only approved overrides.

nodes.summary: Translates the fields stored on an approved Zendesk override ticket into a RegistrationAuthority AddRateLimitOverrideRequest, performing per-field validation and bucket-key composition for each supported rate-limit type.

nodes.name: processTicket
nodes.summary: For one approved Zendesk ticket: builds the RA request, applies the override, and transitions the ticket state with an explanatory comment on success or failure.
